verses.1:1: The words of Jeremiah, son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin.
verses.1:2: The word of the Lord that came to him in the days of Josiah, son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.1:3: And it came in the days of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the completion of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the exile of Jerusalem, in the fifth month.
verses.1:4: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.1:5: "Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you, and before you came out from the womb, I sanctified you, and I gave you as a prophet among the nations."
verses.1:6: And I said, "Ah, ah, ah, Lord God, look, I do not know how to speak, because I am a boy."
verses.1:7: And the Lord said to me, "Do not say, 'I am a boy,' for you will go to all things to which I send you, and you will speak everything, whatever I command you.
verses.1:8: Do not be afraid of their face, because I am with you to rescue you," says the Lord.
verses.1:9: And the Lord extended His hand and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me, "Look, I have placed My words in your mouth.
verses.1:10: Look, today I have appointed you over nations and over kingdoms, to uproot, and to tear down, and to ruin, and to shatter, and to build, and to plant."
verses.1:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "I see a watching rod."
verses.1:12: And the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, because I will watch over My word to do it."
verses.1:13: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a kindled pot, and its face is from the face of the north."
verses.1:14: And the Lord said to me, "From the north evil will be spread out upon all the inhabitants of the land,
verses.1:15: for look, I will call together all the families of the kingdoms of the north," says the Lord, "and they will come, and each one will set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.1:16: And I will speak My judgments with them concerning all the wickedness of those who have abandoned Me, and have offered libations to foreign gods, and have worshiped the work of their own hands.
verses.1:17: You, therefore, gird your loins, and rise up, and speak to them all that I command you. Do not be terrified of their face, for I will not cause you to fear their look.
verses.1:18: For indeed today I have made you a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and a bronze wall against the whole land: the kings of Judah, its princes, and the priests, and the people of the land.
verses.1:19: And they will wage war against you, and they will not prevail, because I am with you," says the Lord, "to deliver you."
verses.2:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.2:2: "Go, and cry out in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, 'This is what the Lord says: I have remembered you, showing compassion on your youth and the love of your betrothal, when you followed Me in the desert, in a land that is not sown.
verses.2:3: Israel is holy to the Lord, the firstfruits of His produce; all who devour him incur guilt; evils will come upon them, says the Lord.'"
verses.2:4: Hear the word of the Lord, house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.
verses.2:5: This is what the Lord says: "What iniquity did your fathers find in Me, that they went far away from Me, and walked after emptiness, and became empty?
verses.2:6: And they did not say, 'Where is the Lord, who caused us to go up from the land of Egypt, who led us through the desert, through an uninhabitable and pathless land, through a land of thirst and the image of death, through a land in which no man walked, nor did any human dwell?'
verses.2:7: And I brought you into the land of Carmel, so that you might eat its fruit and its best things; and when you entered, you defiled My land, and you made My inheritance an abomination.
verses.2:8: The priests did not say, 'Where is the Lord?' and those holding the law did not know Me, and the shepherds transgressed against Me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed idols.
verses.2:9: Therefore I will still contend with you in judgment," says the Lord, "and I will dispute with your sons.
verses.2:10: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and consider intensely, and see whether anything of this kind has happened:
verses.2:11: whether a nation has changed its gods, and indeed they themselves are not gods; yet My people have changed their glory into an idol.
verses.2:12: Be appalled, heavens, at this, and its gates, be utterly desolate," says the Lord.
verses.2:13: "For My people have done two evils: they have abandoned Me, the spring of living water, and dug for themselves cisterns, shattered cisterns, because they are unable to hold waters.
verses.2:14: Is Israel a slave, or a homeborn slave? Why then has he become prey?
verses.2:15: Lions have roared against him and given their voice; they have made his land a desolation. His cities have been burned up, and there is no one to dwell in them.
verses.2:16: Also the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes have violated you all the way to the crown of your head.
verses.2:17: Has this not happened to you because you have abandoned the Lord your God at the time when He was leading you along the way?
verses.2:18: And now what do you want for yourself on the way of Egypt, to drink murky water? And what do you have to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of the river?
verses.2:19: Your wickedness will convict you, and your turning away will rebuke you. Know and see that it is evil and bitter for you to have abandoned the Lord your God, and that the fear of Me is not with you," says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.2:20: "From long ago you broke My yoke, you snapped My bonds, and you said, 'I will not serve.' For on every lofty hill and under every leafy tree, you stretched yourself out as a prostitute.
verses.2:21: Yet I planted you as a choice vine, entirely true seed. How then have you turned for Me into something corrupt, a foreign vine?
verses.2:22: If you wash yourself with natron and multiply for yourself the herb borith, you are stained in your iniquity before Me," says the Lord God.
verses.2:23: "How do you say, 'I am not polluted; I have not walked after the Baals'? See your ways in the valley; know what you have done: a swift runner unfolding her ways.
verses.2:24: A wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness, in the desire of her soul she has drawn in the wind of her love; no one will turn her away. All who seek her will not grow weary; in her menstrual time they will find her.
verses.2:25: Hold back your foot from bareness, and your throat from thirst. Yet you said, 'I have despaired; by no means will I do it, for indeed I have loved strangers, and after them I will walk.'
verses.2:26: Just as a thief is put to shame when he is caught, so the house of Israel have been put to shame, they themselves and their kings, the princes, and the priests, and their prophets,
verses.2:27: saying to wood, 'You are my father,' and to stone, 'You gave birth to me.' They have turned their back to Me and not their face; yet in the time of their affliction they will say, 'Arise and deliver us.'
verses.2:28: Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them arise and deliver you in the time of your affliction, for indeed according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah.
verses.2:29: Why do you want to contend with Me in judgment? All of you have abandoned Me," says the Lord.
verses.2:30: "In vain have I struck your sons; they did not receive discipline. Your sword has devoured your prophets; like a ravaging lion
verses.2:31: is your generation." See the word of the Lord: "Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a late-bearing land? Why then have My people said, 'We have departed; we will not come to You any longer'?
verses.2:32: Will a virgin forget her ornament, or a bride her breastband? Yet My people have forgotten Me for countless days.
verses.2:33: Why do you strive to show your way as good in order to seek love, you who moreover have also taught your ways your wicked deeds,
verses.2:34: and on your skirts has been found the blood of the souls of the poor and the innocent? I did not find them in ditches, but in all the things that I mentioned above.
verses.2:35: And you said, 'I am without sin and innocent, and therefore let Your fury turn away from me.' Look, I will contend with you in judgment, because you have said, 'I have not sinned.'
verses.2:36: How exceedingly worthless you have become, repeating your ways! And you will be put to shame by Egypt, just as you were put to shame by Assyria.
verses.2:37: For from her also you will go out, and your hands will be upon your head, because the Lord has crushed your confidence, and you will have nothing prosperous in it."
verses.3:1: "It is commonly said, 'If a man sends away his wife, and departing from him she marries another man, will he return to her again? Will that woman not be polluted and defiled?' Yet you have committed fornication with many lovers; nevertheless, return to Me," says the Lord, "and I will receive you.
verses.3:2: Lift up your eyes straight ahead, and see where you have not lain prostrate. You sat along the roads, waiting for them like a robber in the wilderness, and you have polluted the land with your fornications and with your wicked deeds.
verses.3:3: For this reason the drops of rain have been withheld, and there has been no late rain. The forehead of a prostitute woman has become yours; you refused to blush.
verses.3:4: Therefore, at least from now on, call to Me, 'My Father, You are the guide of my virginity;
verses.3:5: will You be angry forever, or will You persist to the end?' Look, you have spoken, and you have done evil things, and you have prevailed."
verses.3:6: And the Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, "Have you seen what apostate Israel has done? She went off by herself onto every high mountain and under every leafy tree, and committed fornication there.
verses.3:7: And I said, after she had done all these things, 'Return to Me,' yet she did not return. And her unfaithful sister Judah saw
verses.3:8: that because apostate Israel had committed adultery, I had sent her away and given her a certificate of divorce; yet unfaithful Judah, her sister, did not fear, but went off and committed fornication herself as well.
verses.3:9: And by the ease of her fornication she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stone and wood.
verses.3:10: And in all these things her unfaithful sister Judah has not returned to Me with her whole heart, but in falsehood," says the Lord.
verses.3:11: And the Lord said to me, "Apostate Israel has justified her soul in comparison with unfaithful Judah.
verses.3:12: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and you will say, 'Return, apostate Israel, says the Lord, and I will not turn My face away from you, for I am holy, says the Lord, and I will not be angry forever.
verses.3:13: Nevertheless, acknowledge your iniquity, that you have acted unfaithfully against the Lord your God, and have scattered your ways to strangers under every leafy tree, and have not listened to My voice, says the Lord.'"
verses.3:14: "Turn back, returning sons," says the Lord, "for I am your husband; and I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and I will bring you into Zion.
verses.3:15: And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will feed you with knowledge and teaching.
verses.3:16: And when you have multiplied and increased in the land in those days," says the Lord, "they will no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the Lord,' nor will it come upon the heart, nor will they remember it, nor will it be visited, nor will it be made again.
verses.3:17: At that time they will call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord, and all the nations will be gathered to her in the name of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they will not walk after the depravity of their most wicked heart.
verses.3:18: In those days the house of Judah will go to the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers.
verses.3:19: But I said, 'How shall I place you among the sons and grant you a desirable land, the splendid inheritance of the armies of the nations?' And I said, 'You will call Me Father, and you will not cease to walk after Me.'
verses.3:20: Yet just as when a woman despises her lover, so the house of Israel has despised Me," says the Lord.
verses.3:21: A voice has been heard on the roads, the weeping and wailing of the sons of Israel, because they have made their way unrighteous; they have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.3:22: "Turn back, returning sons, and I will heal your apostasies." "Look, we come to You, for You are the Lord our God.
verses.3:23: Truly the hills were deceitful, and the multitude of the mountains; truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.3:24: Shame has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth: their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.3:25: We will sleep in our shame, and our disgrace will cover us, because we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and we have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.4:1: "If you return, Israel," says the Lord, "turn back to Me; if you remove your stumbling blocks from before My face, you will not be shaken.
verses.4:2: And you will swear, 'The Lord lives,' in truth, and in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations will bless Him, and will praise Him."
verses.4:3: For this is what the Lord says to the man of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up new ground for yourselves, and do not sow upon thorns.
verses.4:4: Be circumcised to the Lord, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that My indignation may not go out like fire and be kindled, with no one to extinguish it, because of the wickedness of your thoughts."
verses.4:5: "Announce in Judah, and make it heard in Jerusalem: speak, and blow the trumpet in the land; cry out loudly and say, 'Gather together, and let us enter the fortified cities.'
verses.4:6: Lift up a standard in Zion; be strengthened, do not stand still, for I am bringing evil from the north, and great destruction."
verses.4:7: A lion has gone up from his lair, and a plunderer of nations has risen up; he has gone out from his place to make your land a desolation. Your cities will be laid waste, remaining without an inhabitant.
verses.4:8: Over this bind sackcloth around yourselves; mourn and wail, because the anger of the fury of the Lord has not turned away from us.
verses.4:9: "And it will be on that day," says the Lord, "the heart of the king will perish, and the heart of the princes, and the priests will be astounded, and the prophets will be dismayed."
verses.4:10: And I said, "Alas! Alas! Alas! Lord God, have You really deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'There will be peace for you,' and look, the sword has reached even to the soul?"
verses.4:11: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, "A scorching wind on the roads that are in the desert of the way of the daughter of My people, not for winnowing or for cleansing.
verses.4:12: A full wind from these will come to Me, and now I will speak My judgments with them."
verses.4:13: Look, he will rise up like clouds, and his chariots like a storm; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, because we have been laid waste!
verses.4:14: Wash your heart from wickedness, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will harmful thoughts lodge within you?
verses.4:15: For there is a voice of one announcing from Dan, and making known an idol from Mount Ephraim.
verses.4:16: Tell the nations, "Look, it has been heard in Jerusalem that watchmen are coming from a distant land and raising their voice against the cities of Judah;
verses.4:17: like watchmen of the fields they have been set over her all around, because she has provoked Me to anger," says the Lord.
verses.4:18: Your ways and your thoughts have done these things to you. This is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it has touched your heart.
verses.4:19: My belly, my belly! I am in pain; the senses of my heart are troubled within me. I will not be silent, because my soul has heard the sound of the horn, the shout of battle.
verses.4:20: Destruction upon destruction has been called out, and the whole land has been laid waste; suddenly my tents have been laid waste, in an instant my skins.
verses.4:21: How long will I see the one fleeing, and hear the sound of the horn?
verses.4:22: "For My foolish people have not known Me; they are unwise and senseless sons. They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have not known how."
verses.4:23: I looked at the earth, and look, it was empty and nothing; and at the heavens, and there was no light in them.
verses.4:24: I saw the mountains, and look, they were shaking, and all the hills were thrown into turmoil.
verses.4:25: I looked intently, and there was no man, and every bird of the heavens had departed.
verses.4:26: I looked, and look, Carmel was a desert, and all its cities were destroyed before the face of the Lord, and before the face of the anger of His fury.
verses.4:27: For this is what the Lord says: "The whole earth will be desolate, yet I will not make a complete end.
verses.4:28: The earth will mourn, and the heavens above will grieve, because I have spoken. I have purposed it, and I have not relented, nor have I turned away from it."
verses.4:29: At the sound of the horseman and the one shooting the arrow, every city has fled; they have entered the steep places and climbed up the cliffs. All the cities have been abandoned, and no man dwells in them.
verses.4:30: And you who are laid waste, what will you do? When you clothe yourself in scarlet, when you are adorned with a golden necklace and paint your eyes with antimony, in vain you beautify yourself. Your lovers have despised you; they will seek your life.
verses.4:31: For I have heard a voice like that of a woman in labor, distress like that of a woman in childbirth: the voice of the daughter of Zion dying away and spreading out her hands, "Woe to me, because my soul has fainted on account of those who have been killed!"
verses.5:1: "Go around the streets of Jerusalem, and look and consider, and search in her squares to see if you can find a man doing justice and seeking faithfulness, and I will be merciful to her.
verses.5:2: And even if they say, 'The Lord lives,' even in this they will swear falsely."
verses.5:3: Lord, Your eyes look upon faithfulness. You struck them, and they felt no pain; You crushed them, and they refused to receive discipline. They hardened their faces more than rock, and they were unwilling to return.
verses.5:4: Then I said, "Perhaps they are poor and foolish, not knowing the way of the Lord, the judgment of their God.
verses.5:5: Therefore I will go to the leading men and speak to them, for they themselves know the way of the Lord, the judgment of their God." Yet look, these all the more have broken the yoke together; they have snapped the bonds.
verses.5:6: Therefore a lion from the forest has struck them, a wolf at evening has ravaged them, a leopard is watching over their cities; everyone who goes out from them will be captured, because their transgressions have multiplied; their turnings away have grown strong.
verses.5:7: "On what ground will I be able to be merciful to you? Your sons have abandoned Me and swear by those who are not gods. I fed them to the full, and they committed adultery, and in the house of a prostitute they lived wantonly.
verses.5:8: They have become lustful horses and stallions; each one was neighing after his neighbor's wife.
verses.5:9: Shall I not bring a reckoning for these things," says the Lord, "and shall My soul not take vengeance on such a nation?
verses.5:10: Go up on her walls and destroy, yet do not make a complete end; remove her branches, for they are not the Lord's.
verses.5:11: For by transgression the house of Israel and the house of Judah have transgressed against Me," says the Lord.
verses.5:12: They have denied the Lord and said, "It is not He, nor will evil come upon us; we will not see sword and famine.
verses.5:13: The prophets have spoken into the wind, and no answer was in them; therefore these things will happen to them."
verses.5:14: This is what the Lord God of hosts says: "Because you have spoken this word, look, I am making My words in your mouth into fire, and this people into wood, and it will devour them.
verses.5:15: Look, I will bring upon you a nation from afar, house of Israel," says the Lord, "a strong nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you will not know, nor will you understand what it speaks.
verses.5:16: Its quiver is like an open tomb; all of them are mighty men.
verses.5:17: And it will eat your crops and your bread; it will devour your sons and your daughters; it will eat your flock and your herds; it will eat your vineyard and your fig tree; and it will crush with the sword your fortified cities in which you have confidence.
verses.5:18: Yet in those days," says the Lord, "I will not bring you to a complete end.
verses.5:19: And if you say, 'Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us?' you will say to them, 'Just as you have abandoned Me and served a foreign god in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.'"
verses.5:20: Announce this to the house of Jacob, and make it heard in Judah, saying:
verses.5:21: "Hear, foolish people, who have no heart, who have eyes and do not see, and ears and do not hear.
verses.5:22: Will you not fear Me, then," says the Lord, "and will you not feel anguish before My face? It is I who placed the sand as a boundary for the sea, an everlasting decree that it will not pass beyond; they will be stirred up, and they will not prevail, and its waves will swell, and they will not cross over it.
verses.5:23: But this people has come to have an unbelieving and provoking heart; they have turned back and gone away.
verses.5:24: And they did not say in their heart, 'Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives us the early and the late rain in its season, preserving for us the fullness of the annual harvest.'
verses.5:25: Your iniquities have turned these things away, and your sins have withheld good from you;
verses.5:26: for wicked men have been found among My people, lying in wait like bird-catchers, setting snares and traps to catch men.
verses.5:27: Just as a trap is full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and rich.
verses.5:28: They have grown stout and fat, and they have passed over My words most wickedly. They have not judged the cause of the widow, they have not set right the cause of the orphan, and they have not judged the right of the poor.
verses.5:29: Shall I not bring a reckoning for these things," says the Lord, "or shall My soul not take vengeance upon a nation of this kind?
verses.5:30: Shock and astonishing things have taken place in the land:
verses.5:31: the prophets were prophesying falsehood, and the priests were applauding with their hands, and My people loved such things. What then will happen at the end of it?"
verses.6:1: Strengthen yourselves, sons of Benjamin, in the midst of Jerusalem; and in Tekoa sound the horn, and over Beth-haccherem raise a banner, because evil has appeared from the north, and great destruction.
verses.6:2: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a beautiful and delicate woman.
verses.6:3: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her; they have pitched tents in her all around; each one will pasture those who are under his hand.
verses.6:4: "Consecrate war against her! Rise up, and let us go up at noon! Woe to us, because the day has declined, because the shadows of evening have grown longer!
verses.6:5: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her houses."
verses.6:6: For this is what the Lord of hosts says: "Cut down her timber, and cast up a mound around Jerusalem. This is the city of visitation; all oppression is in her midst.
verses.6:7: Just as a cistern makes its water cold, so she has made her wickedness cold. Iniquity and devastation will be heard in her; before Me continually are sickness and wound.
verses.6:8: Be instructed, Jerusalem, so that My soul may not depart from you, so that I may not make you desolate, an uninhabitable land."
verses.6:9: This is what the Lord of hosts says: "They will gather the remnant of Israel as in a vineyard, down to the grape cluster. Turn your hand back like a grape-gatherer to the basket."
verses.6:10: To whom shall I speak, and whom shall I solemnly warn so that he may hear? Look, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear; look, the word of the Lord has become a reproach to them, and they will not receive it.
verses.6:11: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord; I have grown weary of holding it in. "Pour it out upon the little child outside, and upon the gathering of young men together; for man with woman will be captured, the old man with the one full of days.
verses.6:12: And their houses will pass over to others, fields and wives alike, because I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land," says the Lord,
verses.6:13: "for indeed, from the least even to the greatest, all devote themselves to greed; and from prophet even to priest, all practice deceit.
verses.6:14: And they were healing the brokenness of the daughter of My people with disgrace, saying, 'Peace, peace!' and there was no peace.
verses.6:15: They were put to shame because they committed abomination; rather, with shame they were not ashamed, and they did not know how to blush. For this reason they will fall among those who fall; at the time of their visitation they will collapse," says the Lord.
verses.6:16: This is what the Lord says: "Stand on the roads and look, and ask about the ancient paths, which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find refreshment for your souls." And they said, "We will not walk."
verses.6:17: "And I appointed watchmen over you: 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!'" And they said, "We will not listen."
verses.6:18: "Therefore hear, nations, and know, congregation, what great things I will do to them.
verses.6:19: Hear, earth: look, I will bring evils upon this people, the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to My words, and they have rejected My law.
verses.6:20: For what purpose do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba, and sweet-smelling cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices have not pleased Me."
verses.6:21: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Look, I will set ruins upon this people, and fathers and sons together will fall in them; neighbor and friend will perish."
verses.6:22: This is what the Lord says: "Look, a people is coming from the land of the north, and a great nation will rise up from the ends of the earth.
verses.6:23: It will seize arrow and shield; it is cruel and will show no mercy. Its voice will resound like the sea, and they will mount horses, prepared like a man for battle against you, daughter of Zion."
verses.6:24: We have heard the report of it; our hands have gone limp. Distress has seized us, pains like a woman in labor.
verses.6:25: Do not go out to the fields, and do not walk on the road, for there is the sword of the enemy, terror all around.
verses.6:26: Daughter of my people, wrap yourself in sackcloth and sprinkle yourself with ashes; make for yourself mourning as for an only son, a bitter lamentation, because suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
verses.6:27: "I have appointed you a strong tester among My people, and you will know and test their way.
verses.6:28: All these are princes turning aside, walking fraudulently, bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
verses.6:29: The bellows have failed; in the fire the lead has been consumed. In vain has the refiner refined, for their acts of wickedness have not been consumed.
verses.6:30: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them."
verses.7:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.7:2: Stand in the gate of the house of the Lord, and proclaim this word there, and say, "Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah, you who enter through these gates to worship the Lord.
verses.7:3: This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Make your ways and your pursuits good, and I will dwell with you in this place.
verses.7:4: Do not trust in words of falsehood, saying, 'The temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, it is the temple of the Lord!'
verses.7:5: For if you rightly direct your ways and your pursuits, if you execute justice between a man and his neighbor,
verses.7:6: if you do not oppress the sojourner, the orphan, and the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after foreign gods to your own harm,
verses.7:7: I will dwell with you in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers from of old and forever.
verses.7:8: Look, you are trusting for yourselves in sayings of falsehood that will not benefit you:
verses.7:9: stealing, murdering, committing adultery, swearing falsely, pouring out drink offerings to the Baals, and going after foreign gods whom you do not know,
verses.7:10: and you have come and stood before Me in this house, in which My name has been invoked, and have said, 'We have been delivered, because we have done all these abominations.'
verses.7:11: Has this house, in which My name has been invoked, then become a cave of robbers in your eyes? I, I am; I have seen it, says the Lord.
verses.7:12: Go to My place in Shiloh, where My name dwelt from the beginning, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.7:13: And now, because you have done all these works, says the Lord, and I spoke to you, rising early in the morning and speaking, and you did not listen, and I called you, and you did not answer,
verses.7:14: I will do to this house, in which My name has been invoked and in which you have confidence, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh;
verses.7:15: and I will cast you away from My presence, just as I cast away all your brothers, the entire seed of Ephraim."
verses.7:16: "As for you, therefore, do not pray for this people, nor take up praise and prayer for them, and do not oppose Me, for I will not hear you.
verses.7:17: Do you not see what these people are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.7:18: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead fat to make cakes for the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings to foreign gods, and to provoke Me to anger.
verses.7:19: Is it Me they are provoking to anger?" says the Lord. "Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own face?"
verses.7:20: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Look, My fury and My indignation are fanned into flame upon this place, upon men, and upon livestock, and upon the trees of the region, and upon the produce of the land, and it will burn, and will not be extinguished."
verses.7:21: This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat the flesh;
verses.7:22: for I did not speak with your fathers, nor did I command them, on the day when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning the matter of burnt offerings and sacrifices;
verses.7:23: but this word I commanded them, saying, 'Listen to My voice, and I will be God to you, and you will be a people to Me; and walk in every way that I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.'
verses.7:24: And they did not listen, nor incline their ear; instead, they went away in the desires and in the perversity of their evil heart, and turned backward and not forward,
verses.7:25: from the day when their fathers came out of the land of Egypt even to this day. And I sent to you all My servants the prophets daily, rising at dawn and sending them;
verses.7:26: yet they did not listen to Me, nor incline their ear; instead, they hardened their neck and acted worse than their fathers."
verses.7:27: And you will speak all these words to them, and they will not listen to you; and you will call to them, and they will not answer you.
verses.7:28: And you will say to them, "This is the nation that did not listen to the voice of the Lord its God, nor accept discipline; faithfulness has perished and has been taken away from their mouth."
verses.7:29: "Cut off your hair and cast it away, and take up a lamentation directly, for the Lord has cast off and abandoned the generation of His fury;
verses.7:30: for the sons of Judah have done evil in My eyes," says the Lord. "They have placed their stumbling blocks in the house in which My name has been invoked, to defile it;
verses.7:31: and they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in fire, things that I did not command, nor think of in My heart.
verses.7:32: Therefore, look, days will come," says the Lord, "and it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; and they will bury in Topheth, because there is no room.
verses.7:33: And the corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to drive them away.
verses.7:34: And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a desolation."
verses.8:1: "At that time," says the Lord, "they will cast out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of those who dwelt in Jerusalem, from their tombs;
verses.8:2: and they will spread them out before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, which they loved, and which they served, and after which they walked, and which they sought, and which they worshiped. They will not be gathered, and they will not be buried; they will become a dung heap upon the face of the earth.
verses.8:3: And they will choose death rather than life, all who remain of this most wicked family, in all the places that are left, to which I have cast them out," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.8:4: And you will say to them, "This is what the Lord says: Does one who falls not rise again? And does one who has turned away not return?
verses.8:5: Why then has this people in Jerusalem turned away with a contentious turning away? They have laid hold of falsehood, and have refused to return.
verses.8:6: I paid attention and listened: no one speaks what is good; there is no one who repents over his sin, saying, 'What have I done?' All have turned to their own course, like a horse rushing headlong into battle.
verses.8:7: The kite in the sky knows its time; the turtledove, the swallow, and the stork observe the time of their coming; but My people do not know the judgment of the Lord.
verses.8:8: How do you say, 'We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us'? Truly, the lying pen of the scribes has produced falsehood!
verses.8:9: The wise have been put to shame; they are terrified and captured; for they have rejected the word of the Lord, and there is no wisdom in them.
verses.8:10: Therefore I will give their wives to outsiders, their fields to inheritors, for from the least even to the greatest, all pursue greed; from prophet even to priest, all practice falsehood."
verses.8:11: And they were healing the fracture of the daughter of My people shamefully, saying, "Peace, peace!" when there was no peace.
verses.8:12: They were put to shame, because they committed an abomination; yet in fact they were not ashamed with any shame, and they did not know how to blush. Therefore they will fall among those who collapse; at the time of their visitation they will collapse, says the Lord.
verses.8:13: "Gathering, I will gather them," says the Lord. "There is no grape on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig tree; the leaf has fallen, and I have given them what has passed away."
verses.8:14: "Why are we sitting here? Assemble, and let us enter the fortified city, and let us be silent there; for the Lord our God has made us silent and has given us water of gall to drink, for we have sinned against the Lord.
verses.8:15: We waited for peace, and there was no good; for a time of healing, and look, terror!"
verses.8:16: From Dan the snorting of his horses was heard; at the sound of the neighing of his warriors the whole land trembled; and they came and devoured the land and its fullness, the city and its inhabitants.
verses.8:17: "For look, I will send among you basilisk serpents, against which there is no charm, and they will bite you," says the Lord.
verses.8:18: My sorrow is upon sorrow; within me my heart is grieving.
verses.8:19: Look, the sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a distant land: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Or is her king not in her?" "Why then have they stirred Me to anger with their carved images and with foreign vanities?"
verses.8:20: "The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, and we have not been saved."
verses.8:21: Over the crushing of the daughter of my people I am crushed and saddened; astonishment has taken hold of me.
verses.8:22: Is there no resin in Gilead? Or is there no physician there? Why then has the scar of the daughter of my people not closed over?
verses.9:1: Who will give water to my head, and to my eyes a fountain of tears, and I will weep day and night for the slaughtered of the daughter of my people?
verses.9:2: Who will give me in the wilderness a lodging place of travelers, that I may leave my people and withdraw from them? For all of them are adulterers, an assembly of transgressors.
verses.9:3: "And they have stretched out their tongue like a bow of falsehood and not of truth; they have grown strong in the land, because they have gone out from evil to evil, and they have not known Me," says the Lord.
verses.9:4: "Let each one guard himself from his neighbor, and let him not have trust in any brother of his; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
verses.9:5: And a man will deride his brother, and they will not speak the truth; for they have taught their tongue to speak falsehood; they have labored to act wickedly.
verses.9:6: Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; in deceit they have refused to know Me," says the Lord.
verses.9:7: Therefore this is what the Lord of hosts says: "Look, I will smelt and test them; for what else should I do because of the daughter of My people?
verses.9:8: Their tongue is a wounding arrow; it has spoken deceit. With his mouth he speaks peace with his friend, and secretly he sets an ambush for him.
verses.9:9: Will I not bring a reckoning for these things," says the Lord, "or will My soul not take vengeance on a nation of this kind?
verses.9:10: Over the mountains I will take up weeping and a lament, and over the fair places of the wilderness a dirge, since they have been burned up, because there is no man passing through, and they have not heard the voice of the owner; from the bird of the sky even to the beasts, they have migrated and withdrawn.
verses.9:11: And I will make Jerusalem into heaps of sand and lairs of dragons; and the cities of Judah I will make into a desolation, because there is no inhabitant."
verses.9:12: Who is the wise man who may understand this, and to whom the word of the mouth of the Lord may come, so that he may declare this: why the land has perished and has been scorched like a wilderness, because there is no one who passes through?
verses.9:13: And the Lord said, "Because they have abandoned My law which I gave them, and have not listened to My voice, and have not walked in it,
verses.9:14: and they have gone after the perversity of their heart and after the Baals, which they learned from their fathers."
verses.9:15: Therefore this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Look, I will feed this people with wormwood, and I will give them water of gall to drink.
verses.9:16: And I will scatter them among the nations which neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send the sword after them until they are consumed."
verses.9:17: This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Consider, and summon the mourning women, and let them come; and send to those who are wise, and let them hurry."
verses.9:18: Let them make haste and take up a lament over us; let our eyes pour down tears, and let our eyelids overflow with waters.
verses.9:19: For a voice of lamentation has been heard from Zion: "How have we been devastated and greatly put to shame? Because we have abandoned the land, since our tents have been thrown down."
verses.9:20: Hear therefore, women, the word of the Lord, and let your ears receive the utterance of His mouth, and teach your daughters a lament, and each woman her neighbor a dirge,
verses.9:21: for death has climbed up through our windows; it has entered our houses, to destroy the little children from outside, the young men from the streets.
verses.9:22: Speak, "This is what the Lord says: 'And the carcass of man will fall like dung upon the face of the region, and like hay behind the back of the reaper, and there is no one to gather it.'"
verses.9:23: This is what the Lord says: "Do not let the wise man boast in his wisdom, and do not let the strong man boast in his strength, and do not let the rich man boast in his riches;
verses.9:24: but in this let the one who boasts boast: to know and recognize Me, that I am the Lord who practices mercy, and judgment, and righteousness on the earth; for these things please Me," says the Lord.
verses.9:25: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will bring a reckoning upon everyone who has a circumcised foreskin,
verses.9:26: upon Egypt, and upon Judah, and upon Edom, and upon the sons of Ammon, and upon Moab, and upon all who are clipped in their hair, dwelling in the wilderness; for all the nations have a foreskin, but the whole house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart."
verses.10:1: Hear the word that the Lord has spoken over you, house of Israel.
verses.10:2: This is what the Lord says: "Do not learn according to the ways of the nations, and do not be afraid of the signs of heaven, which the nations dread,
verses.10:3: for the laws of the peoples are empty. For someone has cut down wood from the forest, the work of the hand of a craftsman with an axe;
verses.10:4: with silver and gold he has adorned it; with nails and hammers he has fastened it together, so that it may not come apart;
verses.10:5: they are fashioned in the likeness of a palm tree, and they will not speak; carried, they will be borne, because they are not able to walk. Do not fear them therefore, because they can do neither evil nor good.
verses.10:6: There is no one like You, Lord; You are great, and Your name is great in strength.
verses.10:7: Who will not fear You, King of the nations? For honor belongs to You; among all the wise of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like You.
verses.10:8: Together they will be proven senseless and foolish; the instruction of their futility is wood.
verses.10:9: Rolled silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of a craftsman and of the hand of a coppersmith. Blue and purple are their clothing; all of these are the work of craftsmen.
verses.10:10: But the Lord is the true God; He is the living God and the eternal King. At His indignation the earth will tremble, and the nations will not endure His threat.
verses.10:11: This, therefore, is what you will say to them, 'May the gods who did not make the heavens and the earth perish from the earth and from these things that are under heaven!'"
verses.10:12: He who makes the earth by His strength, prepares the world by His wisdom, and by His understanding stretches out the heavens:
verses.10:13: at His voice He gives a multitude of waters in heaven, and raises up mists from the ends of the earth; He makes lightning flashes for the rain, and brings out the wind from His treasuries.
verses.10:14: Every man has been made foolish apart from knowledge; every craftsman has been put to shame by a carved image, since what he has cast is false, and there is no spirit in them.
verses.10:15: They are empty, and a work worthy of laughter; in the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.10:16: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for He Himself is the One who formed all things, and Israel is the rod of His inheritance: the Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.10:17: Gather up your shame from the ground, you who dwell under siege,
verses.10:18: for this is what the Lord says: "Look, I will hurl the inhabitants of the land far away at this time, and I will distress them so that they may be found."
verses.10:19: Woe to me over my crushing; my wound is most severe. Yet I said, "Truly this is my infirmity, and I will bear it."
verses.10:20: My tent has been devastated; all my cords have been broken apart; my sons have gone out from me, and they do not remain. There is no one to stretch out my tent any longer and raise up my skins.
verses.10:21: Because the shepherds have acted foolishly and have not sought the Lord, therefore they have not understood, and all their flock has been scattered.
verses.10:22: Look, the sound of a report is coming, and a great commotion from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a wilderness and a dwelling place of dragons.
verses.10:23: I know, Lord, that a person's way is not his own, nor does it belong to a man to walk and direct his steps.
verses.10:24: Correct me, Lord, yet in judgment, and not in Your fury, so that You do not reduce me to nothing.
verses.10:25: Pour out Your indignation upon the nations that have not known You, and upon the provinces that have not called upon Your name; because they have eaten Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and laid waste his splendor.
verses.11:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.11:2: "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
verses.11:3: and you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Cursed is the man who does not listen to the words of this covenant
verses.11:4: which I commanded your fathers on the day when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, "Listen to My voice, and do all things that I command you, and you will be a people for Me, and I will be God for you,"
verses.11:5: so that I may uphold the oath which I swore to your fathers, that I would give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.'" And I answered and said, "Amen, Lord."
verses.11:6: And the Lord said to me, "Cry aloud all these words in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, saying, 'Hear the words of this covenant, and do them,
verses.11:7: for warning, I solemnly warned your fathers on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, up to this day; rising in the morning, I solemnly warned them and said, "Hear My voice."
verses.11:8: And they did not listen, nor did they incline their ear, but they went, each one in the perversity of his evil heart; and I brought upon them all the words of this covenant which I commanded that they should do, and they did not.'"
verses.11:9: And the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.11:10: They have turned back to the former iniquities of their fathers, who refused to listen to My words; and these therefore have gone after foreign gods to serve them; the house of Israel and the house of Judah have made void My covenant which I made with their fathers."
verses.11:11: For this reason this is what the Lord says: "Look, I will bring upon them evils from which they will not be able to come out; and they will cry out to Me, and I will not hear them.
verses.11:12: And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they offer libations, and they will not save them in the time of their affliction.
verses.11:13: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem, you have set up altars of shame, altars for offering libations to the Baals.
verses.11:14: You therefore, do not pray for this people, and do not take up praise and prayer for them, because I will not hear in the time of their cry to Me, in the time of their affliction.
verses.11:15: What is it that My beloved has committed many crimes in My house? Will holy flesh take away from you your wicked deeds, in which you have boasted?
verses.11:16: The Lord called your name a lush olive tree, beautiful, fruitful, lovely; at the sound of speech, a great fire blazed up in it, and its thickets were burned up.
verses.11:17: And the Lord of hosts, who planted you, has spoken evil against you, because of the evils of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves to provoke Me, offering libations to the Baals."
verses.11:18: But You, Lord, showed it to me, and I knew; then You revealed to me their pursuits.
verses.11:19: And I was like a gentle lamb that is carried to the sacrifice; and I did not know that they had devised plans against me, saying, "Let us put wood into his bread, and let us blot him out from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more."
verses.11:20: But You, Lord Sabaoth, who judge justly and test the kidneys and hearts, let me see Your vengeance upon them; for to You I have revealed my cause.
verses.11:21: Therefore this is what the Lord says to the men of Anathoth, who seek your life and say, "You will not prophesy in the name of the Lord, and you will not die at our hands":
verses.11:22: therefore this is what the Lord of hosts says: "Look, I will bring a reckoning upon them: the young men will die by the sword; their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
verses.11:23: And there will be no remnant from them; for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, the year of their visitation."
verses.12:1: Righteous indeed are You, Lord, if I dispute with You; yet I will speak of just things to You: Why does the way of the ungodly prosper, and why is it well with all who transgress and act unjustly?
verses.12:2: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they thrive and bear fruit. You are near to their mouth, and far from their kidneys.
verses.12:3: And You, Lord, know me; You have seen me, and You have tested my heart with You. Gather them together like a flock for sacrifice, and consecrate them for the day of slaughter.
verses.12:4: How long will the land mourn, and the grass of every region dry up, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it? Beast and bird have been consumed, because they have said, "He will not see our final end."
verses.12:5: If you have grown weary running with footmen, how will you be able to contend with horses? And though you have been secure in a land of peace, what will you do in the pride of the Jordan?
verses.12:6: For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they themselves have fought against you, and have cried out after you with a full voice; do not believe them when they speak good things to you.
verses.12:7: I have left My house; I have abandoned My inheritance; I have given My beloved soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.12:8: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest; it has given voice against Me, therefore I have hated it.
verses.12:9: Is My inheritance a multicolored bird to Me? Is it a bird dyed all over? Come, gather together, all you beasts of the earth; hurry to devour.
verses.12:10: Many shepherds have demolished My vineyard; they have trampled My share; they have turned My desirable portion into a desert of solitude.
verses.12:11: They have reduced it to ruin, and it has mourned over Me; with desolation the whole land has been made desolate, because there is no one who reflects in his heart.
verses.12:12: Destroyers have come upon all the ways of the desert, for the sword of the Lord will devour; from one end of the land to the other, there is no peace for all flesh.
verses.12:13: They have sown wheat and reaped thorns; they have received an inheritance, and it will not profit them. You will be put to shame by your fruits because of the wrath of the fury of the Lord.
verses.12:14: This is what the Lord says against all My most wicked neighbors, who touch the inheritance that I distributed to My people Israel: "Look, I will uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from their midst.
verses.12:15: And after I have uprooted them, I will turn back and have mercy on them, and I will bring them back, each man to his own inheritance and each man to his own land.
verses.12:16: And it will be: if, being instructed, they learn the ways of My people, so that they swear by My name, 'The Lord lives!' just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, they will be built up in the midst of My people.
verses.12:17: But if they do not listen, I will uproot that nation with uprooting and destruction," says the Lord.
verses.13:1: This is what the Lord says to me: "Go and acquire for yourself a linen loincloth, and you shall put it upon your loins, and you shall not bring it into water."
verses.13:2: And I acquired a loincloth according to the word of the Lord, and I put it around my loins.
verses.13:3: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying,
verses.13:4: "Take the loincloth that you acquired, which is around your loins, and rising up, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a crevice of a rock."
verses.13:5: And I went away and hid it at the Euphrates, just as the Lord had commanded me.
verses.13:6: And it happened after very many days that the Lord said to me: "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there."
verses.13:7: And I went to the Euphrates, and I dug and took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it; and look, the loincloth had rotted away, so that it was fit for no use.
verses.13:8: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.13:9: "This is what the Lord says: In this way I will cause the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem to rot:
verses.13:10: this most wicked people, who refuse to listen to My words, and walk in the depravity of their heart, and have gone after foreign gods to serve them and to worship them; and they will be like this loincloth, which is fit for no use.
verses.13:11: For just as a loincloth clings to the loins of a man, so I joined the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah closely to Myself, says the Lord, so that they might be for Me a people, and a name, and a praise, and a glory; and they did not listen.
verses.13:12: Therefore you shall speak this word to them: 'This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Every flask will be filled with wine.' And they will say to you, 'Are we unaware that every flask will be filled with wine?'
verses.13:13: And you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord says: Look, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, and the kings of the lineage of David who sit upon his throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.13:14: And I will scatter them, each man from his brother, and the fathers and the sons together, says the Lord. I will not spare, and I will not yield, nor will I have mercy, so as not to destroy them.'"
verses.13:15: Listen, and perceive with your ears; do not be lifted up, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.13:16: Give glory to the Lord your God before it grows dark, and before your feet stumble against the gloomy mountains; you will wait for light, and He will turn it into the shadow of death and into deep gloom.
verses.13:17: But if you do not listen to this, my soul will weep in secret in the face of pride; weeping, it will weep, and my eye will pour down tears, because the flock of the Lord has been taken captive.
verses.13:18: Say to the king and to the sovereign lady: "Humble yourselves, sit down, for the crown of your glory has come down from your head."
verses.13:19: The cities of the south have been shut up, and there is no one to open them; all Judah has been carried away in a complete deportation.
verses.13:20: Lift up your eyes and see, you who come from the north: where is the flock that was given to you, your splendid herd?
verses.13:21: What will you say when He visits you? For you yourself have taught them against you, and instructed them against your own head. Will not pangs seize you, like a woman in labor?
verses.13:22: And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things come upon me?" because of the multitude of your iniquity your private parts have been uncovered; the soles of your feet have been defiled.
verses.13:23: If an Ethiopian can change his skin, or a leopard his spots, then you also will be able to do good, when you have learned evil.
verses.13:24: And I will scatter them abroad like stubble that is snatched away by the wind in the desert.
verses.13:25: This is your lot, and the portion of your measure from Me, says the Lord, because you have forgotten Me, and have trusted in falsehood.
verses.13:26: Therefore I Myself also have laid bare your thighs before your face, and your disgrace has appeared:
verses.13:27: your adulteries, and your neighing, the crime of your fornication; upon the hills in the field I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean after Me; how much longer still?
verses.14:1: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the words of the drought.
verses.14:2: Judea has mourned, and her gates have collapsed and have been darkened upon the ground, and the outcry of Jerusalem has gone up.
verses.14:3: The nobles sent their lesser ones for water; they came to draw it. They did not find water; they brought back their vessels empty. They were put to shame and afflicted, and they covered their heads.
verses.14:4: Because of the devastation of the ground, since no rain came upon the land, the farmers were put to shame; they covered their heads.
verses.14:5: For even the doe in the field gave birth and left, because there was no grass.
verses.14:6: And the wild donkeys stood on the cliffs; they drew in the wind like dragons; their eyes failed, because there was no grass.
verses.14:7: If our iniquities answer against us, Lord, act for the sake of Your name; for our turnings away are many; against You we have sinned.
verses.14:8: Expectation of Israel, its Savior in the time of tribulation, why will You be like a sojourner in the land, and like a traveler turning aside to stay?
verses.14:9: Why will You be like a wandering man, like a mighty man who cannot save? Yet You are among us, Lord, and Your name has been invoked over us; do not abandon us.
verses.14:10: This is what the Lord says to this people, who have loved to move their feet and have not rested, and have not pleased the Lord: "Now He will remember their iniquities, and He will visit their sins."
verses.14:11: And the Lord said to me: "Do not pray for this people for good.
verses.14:12: When they fast, I will not heed their prayers, and if they offer burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not accept them; for by sword, and famine, and plague I will consume them."
verses.14:13: And I said, "Ah, ah, ah, Lord God! The prophets say to them, 'You will not see the sword, and famine will not be among you, but He will give you true peace in this place.'"
verses.14:14: And the Lord says to me: "The prophets prophesy falsely in My name; I did not send them, and I did not command them, nor did I speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, and divination, and fraud, and the deception of their own heart.
verses.14:15: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, whom I did not send, saying, 'Sword and famine will not be in this land': By sword and famine those prophets will be consumed.
verses.14:16: And the people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and the sword, and there will be no one to bury them: they themselves and their wives, their sons and their daughters; and I will pour out upon them their own evil.
verses.14:17: And you shall speak this word to them: 'Let my eyes pour down tears through night and day, and let them not be silent, for with a great crushing the virgin daughter of my people has been crushed, with an exceedingly severe wound.
verses.14:18: If I go out to the fields, look, those killed by the sword! And if I enter into the city, look, those wasted away by famine! The prophet also and the priest have gone away into a land that they did not know.'"
verses.14:19: Have You cast aside and rejected Judah? Or has Your soul abhorred Zion? Why then have You struck us so that there is no healing? We waited for peace, and there is no good; and for a time of healing, and look, turmoil.
verses.14:20: We acknowledge, Lord, our acts of ungodliness, the iniquities of our fathers, for we have sinned against You.
verses.14:21: Do not give us over to reproach, for the sake of Your name, and do not bring upon us the dishonor of the throne of Your glory; remember, do not make void Your covenant with us.
verses.14:22: Are there among the carved images of the nations any who send rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are You not the Lord our God, for whom we have waited? For You Yourself have made all these things.
verses.15:1: And the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My soul is not toward this people; cast them out from My presence, and let them go out.
verses.15:2: And if they say to you, 'Where shall we go out?' you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord says: Whoever is for death, to death; and whoever is for the sword, to the sword; and whoever is for famine, to famine; and whoever is for captivity, to captivity.'
verses.15:3: And I will visit upon them four kinds," says the Lord, "the sword for slaughter, and dogs to tear apart, and the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth to devour and to destroy.
verses.15:4: And I will give them over to agitation for all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, on account of all that he did in Jerusalem.
verses.15:5: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem, or who will grieve for you? Or who will go to ask for your peace?
verses.15:6: You have abandoned Me," says the Lord; "you have gone backward. And I will stretch out My hand over you and kill you; I have grown weary of pleading.
verses.15:7: And I will scatter them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land; I have killed and destroyed My people, and yet they have not turned back from their ways.
verses.15:8: Her widows have been multiplied to Me beyond the sand of the sea; I have brought upon them, against the mother of the young man, a destroyer at midday; I have suddenly sent terror upon the cities.
verses.15:9: She who bore seven has grown weak; her soul has failed; the sun went down for her while it was still day; she has been put to shame and has blushed. And her survivors I will give over to the sword in the sight of their enemies," says the Lord.
verses.15:10: Woe to me, my mother! Why did you give birth to me, a man of strife, a man of discord in all the earth? I have not lent at interest, nor has anyone lent at interest to me; all of them curse me.
verses.15:11: The Lord says, "Surely your remnant is for good; surely I have come to meet you in the time of affliction and in the time of tribulation against the enemy.
verses.15:12: Can iron be allied with iron from the north, and bronze?
verses.15:13: Your riches and your treasures I will give over to plunder without price, because of all your sins and throughout all your borders.
verses.15:14: And I will bring your enemies from a land that you do not know, for a fire has been kindled in My fury; it will burn upon you."
verses.15:15: You know, Lord; remember me and visit me, and defend me from those who persecute me. In Your patience, do not take me up; know that because of You I have endured reproach.
verses.15:16: Your words were found, and I ate them; and Your word became for me joy and gladness of my heart, because Your name has been invoked over me, Lord God of hosts.
verses.15:17: I did not sit in the assembly of those who make merry, and I gloried because of Your hand; I sat alone, because You have filled me with threatening.
verses.15:18: Why has my pain become perpetual, and my hopeless wound refused to be healed? It has become to me like a lie of unfaithful waters.
verses.15:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: "If you turn back, I will bring you back, and you will stand before My face; and if you separate the precious from the worthless, you will be like My mouth. They themselves will turn to you, and you will not turn to them.
verses.15:20: And I will make you for this people a strong wall of bronze; and they will fight against you, and they will not prevail, because I am with you to save you and to rescue you," says the Lord,
verses.15:21: "and I will deliver you from the hand of the most wicked, and I will redeem you from the hand of the strong."
verses.16:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.16:2: "You shall not take a wife, and you shall not have sons and daughters in this place.
verses.16:3: For this is what the Lord says concerning the sons and daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who gave birth to them, and concerning their fathers from whose lineage they were born in this land:
verses.16:4: They will die by deaths of sicknesses; they will not be mourned, and they will not be buried. They will become a dunghill upon the face of the earth, and by sword and by famine they will be consumed; and their corpse will be food for the birds of the sky and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.16:5: For this is what the Lord says: Do not enter a house of feasting, neither go to mourn nor comfort them, for I have taken away My peace from this people," says the Lord, "mercy and compassions.
verses.16:6: And great and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, nor will they be mourned, and they will not cut themselves, nor will baldness be made for them.
verses.16:7: And they will not break bread among them for one who mourns, for comfort over the dead; and they will not give them a drink of the cup for comfort over their father and mother.
verses.16:8: And do not enter a house of feasting to sit with them and eat and drink.
verses.16:9: For this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I will take away from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
verses.16:10: And when you declare to this people all these words, and they say to you, 'Why has the Lord spoken all this great evil against us? What is our iniquity, and what is our sin that we have sinned against the Lord our God?'
verses.16:11: you shall say to them, 'Because your fathers abandoned Me,' says the Lord, 'and went after foreign gods, and served them, and worshiped them, and abandoned Me, and did not keep My law.
verses.16:12: And you yourselves have also acted worse than your fathers; for look, each one walks after the perversity of his evil heart so that he does not listen to Me.
verses.16:13: And I will cast you out of this land into a land that you do not know, you and your fathers; and there you will serve foreign gods day and night, who will not give you rest.'
verses.16:14: Therefore, look, the days are coming," says the Lord, "and it will no longer be said, 'The Lord lives, who brought out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,'
verses.16:15: but, 'The Lord lives, who brought out the sons of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands to which I cast them out.' And I will bring them back into their land, which I gave to their fathers.
verses.16:16: Look, I will send many fishermen," says the Lord, "and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send them many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and from the caverns of the rocks.
verses.16:17: For My eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, and their iniquity has not been concealed from My eyes.
verses.16:18: And first I will repay double for their iniquities and their sins, because they have defiled My land with the carcasses of their idols, and with their abominations they have filled My inheritance."
verses.16:19: Lord, my strength and my might and my refuge in the day of tribulation, to You the nations will come from the ends of the earth and will say, "Truly our fathers possessed a lie, a vanity that did not profit them."
verses.16:20: Can a man make gods for himself, when they themselves are not gods?
verses.16:21: "Therefore, look, I will show them this time; I will show them My hand and My power, and they will know that My name is the Lord."
verses.17:1: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, with a diamond point, engraved upon the breadth of their heart and on the horns of their altars.
verses.17:2: When their children remember their altars, and their sacred groves, and the leafy trees on the high mountains,
verses.17:3: sacrificing in the field: I will give your strength and all your treasures over to plunder; your high places, because of sins throughout all your borders.
verses.17:4: And you will be left alone, apart from your inheritance that I gave you, and I will make you serve your enemies in a land that you do not know; for you have kindled a fire in My fury: it will burn forever.
verses.17:5: This is what the Lord says: "Cursed is the man who trusts in man and sets flesh as his arm, and whose heart departs from the Lord.
verses.17:6: For he will be like tamarisks in the desert, and he will not see when good comes; but he will dwell in dryness in the desert, in a salty and uninhabitable land.
verses.17:7: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord will be his confidence.
verses.17:8: And he will be like a tree that is transplanted by the waters, which sends its roots toward the moisture, and it will not fear when the heat comes; and its leaf will be green, and in a time of drought it will not be anxious, nor will it ever cease to produce fruit.
verses.17:9: Perverse is the heart of all, and unsearchable; who will know it?
verses.17:10: I am the Lord, searching the heart and testing the kidneys, who give to each one according to his way and according to the fruit of his devices.
verses.17:11: The partridge has brooded over what she did not lay; he has made riches, and not with justice: in the middle of his days he will leave them, and at his end he will be a fool."
verses.17:12: A throne of glory on high from the beginning, the place of our sanctification.
verses.17:13: Expectation of Israel, Lord, all who abandon You will be put to shame; those who depart from You will be written in the earth, because they have abandoned the vein of living waters, the Lord.
verses.17:14: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, because You are my praise.
verses.17:15: Look, they themselves say to me, "Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come."
verses.17:16: And I have not been troubled, following You as Shepherd, and the day of man I have not desired, You know; what came out of my lips was right in Your sight.
verses.17:17: Do not be a terror to me; You are my hope in the day of affliction.
verses.17:18: Let those who persecute me be put to shame, and let me not be put to shame; let them be terrified, and let me not be terrified; bring upon them the day of affliction, and crush them with a double crushing.
verses.17:19: This is what the Lord says to me: "Go and stand in the gate of the sons of the people, through which the kings of Judah enter and go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.17:20: and you shall say to them, 'Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
verses.17:21: This is what the Lord says: Guard your souls, and do not carry burdens on the Sabbath day, nor bring them in through the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.17:22: and do not bring loads out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and you shall not do any work; sanctify the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.17:23: And they did not listen, nor did they incline their ear, but they hardened their neck so that they would not listen to Me and would not receive discipline.
verses.17:24: And it will come to pass: if you listen to Me,' says the Lord, 'so that you do not bring loads in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and if you sanctify the Sabbath day so that you do not do any work on it,
verses.17:25: kings and princes will enter through the gates of this city, sitting upon the throne of David and riding in chariots and on horses, they themselves and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited forever.
verses.17:26: And they will come from the cities of Judah, and from around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plains, and from the hill country, and from the south, bringing burnt offering, and sacrificial victim, and sacrifice, and frankincense, and they will bring an offering into the house of the Lord.
verses.17:27: But if you do not listen to Me to sanctify the Sabbath day, and not to carry a load and not to bring one in through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the houses of Jerusalem, and it will not be extinguished.'"
verses.18:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.18:2: "Rise, and go down to the potter's house, and there you will hear My words."
verses.18:3: And I went down to the potter's house, and look, he was doing work on the wheel.
verses.18:4: And the vessel that he was making out of clay with his hands was ruined; and turning again, he made it into another vessel, just as it had been pleasing in his eyes to make.
verses.18:5: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.18:6: "Can I not do to you just as this potter does, house of Israel?" says the Lord. "Look, just as clay is in the hand of the potter, so are you in My hand, house of Israel.
verses.18:7: Suddenly I will speak against a nation and against a kingdom, to uproot, and to tear down, and to destroy it;
verses.18:8: if that nation repents from its evil that I have spoken against it, I also will repent over the evil that I have planned to do to it.
verses.18:9: And in a moment I will speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it.
verses.18:10: If it does evil in My eyes, so that it does not listen to My voice, I will repent over the good that I have spoken of doing for it.
verses.18:11: Now therefore speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, 'This is what the Lord says: Look, I am fashioning evil against you and devising a plan against you. Let each one turn back from his evil way, and direct your ways and your pursuits.'"
verses.18:12: And they said, "We have despaired; for we will go after our own plans, and each of us will practice the depravity of his evil heart."
verses.18:13: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Ask the nations: Who has heard such horrible things as the virgin Israel has exceedingly done?
verses.18:14: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Or can the cold waters bursting forth and flowing down be torn away?
verses.18:15: Because My people have forgotten Me, pouring out libations in vain, and stumbling in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk through them on an untrodden road,
verses.18:16: so that their land would become a desolation and an everlasting hissing; everyone who passes through it will be astonished and will shake his head.
verses.18:17: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, on the day of their destruction."
verses.18:18: And they said, "Come, and let us devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law will not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise man, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us pay no attention to any of his words."
verses.18:19: Pay attention to me, Lord, and hear the voice of my adversaries.
verses.18:20: Is evil repaid for good, that they have dug a pit for my soul? Remember that I stood in Your sight to speak good for them, and to turn away Your indignation from them.
verses.18:21: Therefore give their sons over to famine, and bring them down into the hands of the sword; let their wives become childless and widows, and let their husbands be killed by death; let their young men be pierced by the sword in battle.
verses.18:22: Let a cry be heard from their houses, for You will suddenly bring a robber upon them, because they have dug a pit to capture me, and have hidden snares for my feet.
verses.18:23: But You, Lord, know all their counsel against me for death; do not be merciful toward their iniquity, and let their sin not be blotted out from Your face; let them collapse in Your sight; in the time of Your fury, deal harshly with them.
verses.19:1: This is what the Lord says: "Go, and take a potter's earthenware flask from the elders of the people and from the elders of the priests,
verses.19:2: and go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is near the entrance of the Pottery Gate; and you will proclaim there the words that I will speak to you.
verses.19:3: And you will say, 'Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I will bring affliction upon this place, so that the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle,
verses.19:4: because they have abandoned Me, and have made this place foreign, and have poured out libations in it to foreign gods whom they did not know, they and their fathers and the kings of Judah; and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent,
verses.19:5: and they have built the high places of the Baals, to burn their sons with fire as a burnt offering to the Baals, things that I did not command or speak, nor did they come up into My heart.
verses.19:6: Therefore look, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Topheth and the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.19:7: And I will ruin the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will overthrow them by the sword in the sight of their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their lives; and I will give their corpses as food to the birds of the sky and to the beasts of the earth.
