verses.19:8: And I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing; everyone who passes through it will be astonished and will hiss over its entire plague.
verses.19:9: And I will feed them with the flesh of their sons and with the flesh of their daughters, and each one will eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress in which their enemies and those who seek their lives will shut them in.'
verses.19:10: And you will shatter the flask in the eyes of the men who will go with you,
verses.19:11: and you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord of hosts says: So I will shatter this people and this city, just as a potter's vessel is shattered, which can no longer be restored; and they will be buried in Topheth, because there is no other place for burying.
verses.19:12: So I will do to this place, says the Lord, and to its inhabitants, and I will make this city like Topheth.
verses.19:13: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be like the place of Topheth, unclean, all the houses on whose rooftops they sacrificed to all the host of heaven and poured out libations to foreign gods.'"
verses.19:14: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the Lord and said to all the people:
verses.19:15: "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I will bring upon this city and upon all its towns all the evils that I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their neck so that they would not listen to My words."
verses.20:1: And Pashhur the son of Immer, the priest, who had been appointed ruler in the house of the Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
verses.20:2: And Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper Gate of Benjamin, in the house of the Lord.
verses.20:3: And when it had grown light on the next day, Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks, and Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord has not called your name Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.
verses.20:4: For this is what the Lord says: 'Look, I will give you over to terror, you and all your friends; and they will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will lead them away into Babylon and strike them with the sword.
verses.20:5: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and all its labor, and everything of value, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies; and they will plunder them, and take them, and bring them into Babylon.
verses.20:6: And you, Pashhur, and all the inhabitants of your house, will go into captivity; and you will come into Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied falsehood.'"
verses.20:7: You have deceived me, Lord, and I was deceived; You were stronger than I, and You prevailed. I have become a mockery all day long; everyone sneers at me.
verses.20:8: Because for a long time now I have been speaking, shouting out iniquity and repeatedly crying out devastation; and the word of the Lord has become for me a reproach and a mockery all day long.
verses.20:9: And I said, "I will not remember Him, nor will I speak anymore in His name." And it became in my heart like a blazing fire, shut up in my bones; and I grew weary, unable to endure bearing it.
verses.20:10: For I have heard the insults of many, and terror all around, "Pursue, and let us pursue him!" from all the men who were at peace with me and watching my side: "Perhaps somehow he may be deceived, and we may prevail against him, and obtain vengeance from him."
verses.20:11: But the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior; therefore those who pursue me will fall and will be weak; they will be greatly put to shame, because they have not understood the everlasting reproach, which will never be blotted out.
verses.20:12: And You, Lord of hosts, tester of the righteous, who see the kidneys and the heart, please let me see Your vengeance on them; for to You I have revealed my cause.
verses.20:13: Sing to the Lord, praise the Lord, for He has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of the wicked.
verses.20:14: Cursed be the day on which I was born! May the day on which my mother bore me not be blessed!
verses.20:15: Cursed be the man who brought news to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you!" and made him glad as with joy!
verses.20:16: Let that man be like the cities that the Lord overthrew, and He did not relent; let him hear an outcry in the morning, and a wailing at midday,
verses.20:17: who did not kill me from the womb, so that my mother might become a tomb for me, and her womb an everlasting pregnancy!
verses.20:18: Why did I come out from the womb to see toil and sorrow, and for my days to be consumed in shame?
verses.21:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
verses.21:2: "Inquire of the Lord for us, because Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, is waging war against us; perhaps the Lord will deal with us according to all His wonders, and he will withdraw from us."
verses.21:3: And Jeremiah said to them, "This is what you shall say to Zedekiah:
verses.21:4: 'This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Look, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, and with which you are fighting against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are besieging you around the walls; and I will gather them in the middle of this city.
verses.21:5: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, and in fury, and in indignation, and in great wrath.
verses.21:6: And I will strike the inhabitants of this city: people and beasts will die by a great pestilence.
verses.21:7: And after these things, says the Lord, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and his people, and those who are left in this city from the plague, and the sword, and the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life; and he will strike them with the edge of the sword, and he will not be moved, nor will he spare, nor will he have mercy.'"
verses.21:8: And to this people you shall say, "This is what the Lord says: Look, I place before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.21:9: Whoever dwells in this city will die by the sword, and by famine, and by plague; but whoever goes out and deserts to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and his life will be to him like spoil.
verses.21:10: For I have set My face against this city for evil and not for good, says the Lord; it will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it up with fire."
verses.21:11: And to the house of the king of Judah: "Hear the words of the Lord,
verses.21:12: house of David. This is what the Lord says: Render judgment in the morning, and rescue the one oppressed by force from the hand of the extortioner, so that My indignation may not go out like fire and be kindled, and there be no one to extinguish it, because of the wickedness of your practices.
verses.21:13: Look, I am against you, dweller of the solid and level valley, says the Lord, you who say, 'Who will strike us? And who will enter our houses?'
verses.21:14: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your practices, says the Lord; and I will kindle a fire in its forest, and it will devour everything around it."
verses.22:1: This is what the Lord says: "Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and there you shall speak this word,
verses.22:2: and you shall say, 'Hear the word of the Lord, king of Judah, you who sit on the throne of David: you and your servants and your people, who enter through these gates.
verses.22:3: This is what the Lord says: Execute judgment and justice, and deliver the one oppressed by force from the hand of the extortioner; and do not distress the stranger, the orphan, and the widow, nor oppress them unjustly, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.22:4: For if you truly carry out this word, then kings of the lineage of David sitting on his throne will enter through the gates of this house, riding chariots and horses, they themselves, and their servants, and their people.
verses.22:5: But if you do not listen to these words, I have sworn by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.'"
verses.22:6: For this is what the Lord says concerning the house of the king of Judah: "You are Gilead to Me, the summit of Lebanon; yet I will surely make you a desolation, uninhabitable cities!
verses.22:7: And I will consecrate against you a destroying man and his weapons; and they will cut down your choice cedars and hurl them into the fire.
verses.22:8: And many nations will pass through this city, and each one will say to his neighbor, 'Why has the Lord done so to this great city?'
verses.22:9: And they will answer, 'Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshiped foreign gods, and served them.'"
verses.22:10: Do not weep for the dead one, nor mourn over him with weeping; lament for the one who goes away, because he will not return again, nor will he see the land of his birth.
verses.22:11: For this is what the Lord says concerning Shallum, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: "He will not return here anymore,
verses.22:12: but in the place to which I carried him away, there he will die, and he will not see this land anymore."
verses.22:13: Woe to the one who builds his house in injustice, and his upper rooms not in judgment; he will oppress his friend for nothing, and he will not pay him his wages;
verses.22:14: who says, "I will build for myself a wide house and spacious upper rooms"; who opens windows for himself, and makes paneled ceilings of cedar, and paints with vermilion.
verses.22:15: Will you reign because you compare yourself to cedar? Did not your father eat and drink, and execute judgment and justice, then when it was well with him?
verses.22:16: He judged the cause of the poor and needy for his own good; was it not for this reason, because he knew Me?—says the Lord.
verses.22:17: But your eyes and heart are set on greed, and on shedding innocent blood, and on extortion, and on the course of evil work.
verses.22:18: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They will not lament for him, 'Alas, brother!' and 'Alas, sister!' They will not cry aloud for him, 'Alas, lord!' and 'Alas, glorious one!'
verses.22:19: With the burial of a donkey he will be buried, decayed and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem."
verses.22:20: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan raise your voice; and cry out to those passing by, because all your lovers have been shattered.
verses.22:21: I spoke to you in your abundance, and you said, "I will not listen." This is your way from your youth, because you have not listened to My voice.
verses.22:22: The wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity; and then you will be put to shame and blush because of all your wickedness.
verses.22:23: You who sit in Lebanon and make your nest in the cedars, how did you groan when pains came upon you, like the pains of a woman in labor?
verses.22:24: "As I live, says the Lord, even if Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a ring on My right hand, yet from there I would pull him off,
verses.22:25: and I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of those whose face you dread, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans;
verses.22:26: and I will cast you, and your mother who bore you, into a foreign land in which you were not born, and there you will die.
verses.22:27: And to the land toward which they lift up their soul to return there, they will not return."
verses.22:28: Is this man Jeconiah an earthen and shattered vessel? Is he a vessel without any pleasure? Why have he and his seed been cast away, and hurled into a land that they did not know?
verses.22:29: Land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.22:30: This is what the Lord says: "Write this man down as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for there will not be a man from his seed who will sit on the throne of David and have power anymore in Judah."
verses.23:1: "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and tear apart the flock of My pasture!" says the Lord.
verses.23:2: Therefore this is what the Lord God of Israel says to the shepherds who tend My people: "You have scattered My flock and driven them out, and have not visited them. Look, I will visit upon you the wickedness of your practices," says the Lord.
verses.23:3: "And I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I will have driven them, and I will bring them back to their own fields, and they will increase and multiply.
verses.23:4: And I will raise up shepherds over them, and they will tend them; they will no longer be afraid, nor will they be terrified, and none will be missing from the number," says the Lord.
verses.23:5: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will raise up for David a righteous shoot; and a king will reign, and He will be wise, and He will carry out judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.23:6: In those days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell confidently; and this is the name by which they will call Him: 'The Lord Our Righteous One.'"
verses.23:7: "Therefore, look, days are coming," says the Lord, "when they will no longer say, 'As the Lord lives, who led the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,'
verses.23:8: but rather, 'As the Lord lives, who led out and brought the seed of the house of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands to which I had driven them,' and they will dwell in their own land."
verses.23:9: Concerning the prophets: my heart is crushed within me; all my bones tremble; I have become like a drunken man, and like a man drenched with wine, before the presence of the Lord and before His holy words.
verses.23:10: For the land is filled with adulterers; for because of the curse the land has mourned, and the fields of the wilderness have dried up; their course has become evil, and their strength is inconsistent.
verses.23:11: "For prophet and priest are defiled, and in My house I have found their evil," says the Lord.
verses.23:12: "Therefore their way will be like a slippery place in the darkness; for they will be pushed forward and fall down in it; for I will bring calamities upon them, the year of their visitation," says the Lord.
verses.23:13: "And among the prophets of Samaria I saw foolishness: they prophesied by Baal and deceived My people Israel.
verses.23:14: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I saw the likeness of adulterers and a path of falsehood; and they strengthened the hands of the most wicked, so that no one would turn back from his wickedness; all of them have become to Me like Sodom, and its inhabitants like Gomorrah."
verses.23:15: Therefore this is what the Lord of hosts says concerning the prophets: "Look, I will feed them with wormwood and give them gall to drink; for from the prophets of Jerusalem defilement has gone out over all the land."
verses.23:16: This is what the Lord of hosts says: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you and deceive you; they speak a vision of their own heart, not from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.23:17: They say to those who blaspheme Me, 'The Lord has spoken: "Peace will be yours"'; and to everyone who walks in the depravity of his own heart they have said, 'No evil will come upon you.'"
verses.23:18: For who has been present in the council of the Lord, and has seen and heard His word? Who has considered His word and listened?
verses.23:19: Look, the whirlwind of the Lord's indignation will go out, and a storm bursting out will come upon the head of the ungodly.
verses.23:20: The fury of the Lord will not turn back until He carries out and until He fulfills the thought of His heart; in the last days you will understand His counsel.
verses.23:21: "I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.23:22: If they had stood in My council and had made My words known to My people, I would certainly have turned them back from their evil way and from their most wicked thoughts."
verses.23:23: "Do you think I am a God nearby," says the Lord, "and not a God far away?"
verses.23:24: "If a man hides himself in secret places, will I not see him?" says the Lord. "Do I not fill heaven and earth?" says the Lord.
verses.23:25: "I have heard what the prophets have said, prophesying falsehood in My name and saying, 'I have dreamed, I have dreamed!'
verses.23:26: How long is this in the heart of the prophets who foretell falsehood and prophesy the deceptions of their own heart,
verses.23:27: who want to make My people forget My name because of their dreams, which each one tells to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name because of Baal?
verses.23:28: Let the prophet who has a dream tell the dream, and let the one who has My word speak My word truthfully. What does chaff have to do with wheat?" says the Lord.
verses.23:29: "Are not My words like fire," says the Lord, "and like a hammer shattering rock?"
verses.23:30: "Therefore, look, I am against the prophets," says the Lord, "who steal My words, each one from his neighbor."
verses.23:31: "Look, I am against the prophets," says the Lord, "who take up their own tongues and say, 'The Lord says.'"
verses.23:32: "Look, I am against the prophets who dream falsehoods," says the Lord, "who recounted them and led My people astray by their falsehood and by their miracles, when I had not sent them nor commanded them; who have not profited this people at all," says the Lord.
verses.23:33: "Therefore, if this people, or a prophet, or a priest asks you, saying, 'What is the burden of the Lord?' you will say to them, 'You are the burden, for I will cast you off,'" says the Lord.
verses.23:34: "And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people who say, 'The burden of the Lord,' I will punish that man and his house."
verses.23:35: This is what each of you will say to his neighbor and to his brother: "What has the Lord answered? And what has the Lord spoken?"
verses.23:36: And "the burden of the Lord" will no longer be mentioned; for each one's own word will be a burden to him, and you have perverted the words of the living God, the Lord of hosts, our God.
verses.23:37: This is what you will say to the prophet: "What has the Lord answered you? And what has the Lord spoken?"
verses.23:38: But if you say, "The burden of the Lord," for this reason this is what the Lord says: "Because you have spoken this word, 'The burden of the Lord,' and I sent to you saying, 'Do not say, "The burden of the Lord,"'
verses.23:39: therefore, look, I will lift you up and carry you, and I will abandon you, and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from My presence;
verses.23:40: and I will give you over to an everlasting reproach and to an eternal disgrace, which will never be blotted out by forgetfulness."
verses.24:1: The Lord showed me, and look, two baskets full of figs were set before the temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and his princes, and the craftsman, and the locksmith, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.24:2: One basket had very good figs, such as figs of the first season usually are; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten because they were bad.
verses.24:3: And the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs, good figs, very good, and bad ones, very bad, which cannot be eaten because they are bad."
verses.24:4: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.24:5: "This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Like these good figs, so I will regard the exiles of Judah, whom I sent out from this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.
verses.24:6: And I will set My eyes upon them to be appeased, and I will bring them back into this land; and I will build them up and not tear them down, and I will plant them and not uproot them.
verses.24:7: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord; and they will be My people, and I will be their God, because they will return to Me with their whole heart.
verses.24:8: And like the worst figs, which cannot be eaten because they are bad—this is what the Lord says—so I will give over Zedekiah king of Judah, and his princes, and the rest from Jerusalem who have remained in this city, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
verses.24:9: And I will give them over to distress and affliction among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a reproach, and a parable, and a proverb, and a curse in all the places to which I have driven them.
verses.24:10: And I will send among them the sword, and famine, and plague, until they are consumed from the land that I gave to them and to their fathers."
verses.25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah (that is the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.25:2: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.25:3: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, until this day—this is the twenty-third year—the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising in the night and speaking, yet you have not listened.
verses.25:4: And the Lord sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising at daybreak and sending them; yet you did not listen, nor did you incline your ears to hear,
verses.25:5: when He said, 'Turn back, each one from his evil way and from your most wicked thoughts, and you will dwell in the land that the Lord gave to you and to your fathers, from everlasting to everlasting;
verses.25:6: and do not go after foreign gods to serve them and worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands, and I will not afflict you.'
verses.25:7: 'Yet you did not listen to Me,' says the Lord, 'so that you provoked Me to anger with the works of your hands, to your own harm.'
verses.25:8: Therefore this is what the Lord of hosts says: 'Because you have not listened to My words,
verses.25:9: look, I will send and take all the families of the north,' says the Lord, 'and Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and I will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all the nations that are around it; and I will put them to death, and I will make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and everlasting desolations.
verses.25:10: And I will destroy from among them the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstone and the light of the lamp.
verses.25:11: And this entire land will become a desolation and an astonishment; and all these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
verses.25:12: And when the seventy years have been fulfilled, I will visit upon the king of Babylon and upon that nation,' says the Lord, 'their iniquity, and upon the land of the Chaldeans, and I will make it everlasting desolations.
verses.25:13: And I will bring upon that land all My words that I have spoken against it, everything that is written in this book, whatever Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations,
verses.25:14: for they have served them, although they were many nations and great kings; and I will repay them according to their works and according to the deeds of their hands.'"
verses.25:15: For this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Take the cup of the wine of this fury from My hand, and you shall give drink from it to all the nations to which I will send you.
verses.25:16: And they will drink, and be thrown into turmoil, and go mad before the sword that I will send among them."
verses.25:17: And I took the cup from the hand of the Lord, and gave drink to all the nations to which the Lord sent me:
verses.25:18: to Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to give them over to desolation, and to astonishment, and to hissing, and to a curse, as it is this day;
verses.25:19: to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.25:20: and to all in general: all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.25:21: and Idumea, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon;
verses.25:22: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the land of the islands who are across the sea;
verses.25:23: and Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who have their hair clipped;
verses.25:24: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the west who dwell in the desert;
verses.25:25: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.25:26: also all the kings of the north, from near and from far, each one against his brother, and all the kingdoms of the earth that are upon its face; and the king of Sheshach will drink after them.
verses.25:27: And you shall say to them, "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'Drink, and get drunk, and vomit, and fall, and do not rise before the sword that I will send among you.'"
verses.25:28: And when they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, you shall say to them, "This is what the Lord of hosts says: 'You will certainly drink;
verses.25:29: for look, in the city in which My name has been invoked I will begin to bring affliction, and will you be as innocent and exempt? You will not be exempt; for I am calling a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth,' says the Lord of hosts."
verses.25:30: And you shall prophesy to them all these words, and you shall say to them: "The Lord will roar from on high, and from His holy dwelling He will utter His voice; roaring, He will roar over His beauty; a chant like that of treaders will be sung in chorus against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.25:31: The sound has reached to the ends of the earth, because the Lord has a judgment with the nations; He Himself enters into judgment with all flesh. 'The wicked I have handed over to the sword,' says the Lord."
verses.25:32: This is what the Lord of hosts says: "Look, affliction will go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind will go forth from the farthest bounds of the earth.
verses.25:33: And those killed by the Lord on that day will be from one end of the earth to the other end of it; they will not be mourned, and they will not be gathered, nor will they be buried; they will lie as dung upon the face of the earth."
verses.25:34: Wail, shepherds, and cry out, and sprinkle yourselves with ashes, leaders of the flock, for your days have been completed for you to be killed, and your dispersions; and you will fall like precious vessels.
verses.25:35: And flight will perish from the shepherds, and deliverance from the leaders of the flock.
verses.25:36: The sound of the outcry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leaders of the flock! For the Lord has laid waste their pastures,
verses.25:37: and the fields of peace have fallen silent before the wrath of the fury of the Lord.
verses.25:38: Like a lion He has abandoned His shelter, for their land has become a desolation before the wrath of the dove, and before the wrath of the fury of the Lord.
verses.26:1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the Lord, saying:
verses.26:2: "This is what the Lord says: Stand in the courtyard of the house of the Lord, and you will speak to all the cities of Judah, from which they come to worship in the house of the Lord, all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them; do not hold back a word;
verses.26:3: perhaps they will listen and turn back, each one from his evil way, and I will relent of the harm that I intend to do to them because of the wickedness of their practices.
verses.26:4: And you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord says: If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My law which I have given to you,
verses.26:5: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I have sent to you, rising up in the night and dispatching them, and you have not listened,
verses.26:6: I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will make a curse for all the nations of the earth.'"
verses.26:7: And the priests, and the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.26:8: And when Jeremiah had finished speaking everything that the Lord had commanded him to speak to the whole people, the priests, and the prophets, and all the people seized him, saying, "Let him surely die!
verses.26:9: Why has he prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, 'This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be made desolate because there is no inhabitant'?" And all the people gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.26:10: And the princes of Judah heard these words, and they went up from the house of the king into the house of the Lord, and they sat at the entrance of the new gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.26:11: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, "A sentence of death is due to this man, because he has prophesied against this city, just as you have heard with your ears."
verses.26:12: And Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to the whole people, saying, "The Lord sent me to prophesy to this house and to this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.26:13: Now therefore make your ways and your practices good, and listen to the voice of the Lord your God, and the Lord will relent of the harm that He has spoken against you.
verses.26:14: But as for me, here I am in your hands; do to me what is good and right in your eyes.
verses.26:15: However, know and understand that if you kill me, you will bring innocent blood against yourselves, and against this city and its inhabitants; for in truth the Lord sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears."
verses.26:16: And the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, "No sentence of death is due to this man, because he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.26:17: Then men from the elders of the land rose up, and they spoke to the entire assembly of the people, saying:
verses.26:18: "Micah of Moresheth was a prophet in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, 'This is what the Lord of hosts says: Zion will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become a heap of stones, and the mountain of the house, high places of the forests.'
verses.26:19: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah condemn him to death? Did they not fear the Lord and implore the face of the Lord, and the Lord relented of the harm that He had spoken against them? Therefore we are doing great harm against our souls."
verses.26:20: There was also a man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Uriah son of Shimei, of Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.26:21: And King Jehoiakim, and all his powerful men and princes, heard these words, and the king sought to kill him; and Uriah heard, and was afraid, and fled, and entered Egypt.
verses.26:22: And King Jehoiakim sent men into Egypt, Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him, into Egypt,
verses.26:23: and they brought Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to King Jehoiakim, and he struck him with the sword and threw his corpse into the graves of the lowly common people.
verses.26:24: So the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he was not handed over into the hands of the people for them to kill him.
verses.27:1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.27:2: This is what the Lord says to me: "Make for yourself bonds and chains, and you will put them on your neck,
verses.27:3: and you will send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the sons of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.27:4: And you will command them to speak to their masters, 'This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: This is what you will say to your masters:
verses.27:5: I made the earth, and the people, and the livestock that are upon the face of the earth, by My great strength and by My outstretched arm, and I have given it to the one who was pleasing in My eyes.
verses.27:6: And now therefore I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant; moreover, I have also given him the beasts of the field, that they may serve him.
verses.27:7: And all the nations will serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the time of his land and of himself comes; and many nations and great kings will serve him.
verses.27:8: But as for the nation and kingdom that will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and whoever will not bend his neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will visit that nation with the sword, and with famine, and with pestilence, says the Lord, until I consume them by his hand.
verses.27:9: You therefore, do not listen to your prophets, and diviners, and dreamers, and augurs, and sorcerers, who say to you, "You will not serve the king of Babylon,"
verses.27:10: for they prophesy a lie to you, so that they may put you far from your land, and drive you out, and you may perish.
verses.27:11: But as for the nation that submits its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will leave it in its own land, says the Lord, and it will cultivate it and live in it.'"
verses.27:12: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying, "Submit your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and you will live.
verses.27:13: Why will you die, you and your people, by sword, and by famine, and by pestilence, just as the Lord has spoken concerning the nation that refuses to serve the king of Babylon?
verses.27:14: Do not listen to the words of the prophets saying to you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' for they themselves speak a lie to you,
verses.27:15: for I have not sent them, says the Lord, and they themselves prophesy falsely in My name, so that they may drive you out, and you may perish, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you."
verses.27:16: And to the priests and to this people I spoke, saying, "This is what the Lord says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, 'Look, the vessels of the Lord will return from Babylon soon now,' for they prophesy a lie to you.
verses.27:17: Therefore do not listen to them, but serve the king of Babylon, so that you may live. Why is this city being given over to desolation?
verses.27:18: And if they are prophets, and the word of the Lord is in them, let them intercede with the Lord of hosts so that the vessels that had been left behind in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, may not come into Babylon.
verses.27:19: For this is what the Lord of hosts says concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that have remained in this city,
verses.27:20: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem into Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem:
verses.27:21: for this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that were left behind in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
verses.27:22: 'They will be carried away into Babylon, and there they will be until the day of their visitation, says the Lord, and I will cause them to be brought and restored in this place.'"
verses.28:1: And it happened in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah son of Azzur, the prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord, before the priests and all the people, saying:
verses.28:2: "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I have shattered the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.28:3: Still two years of days, and I will cause to be brought back to this place all the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took from this place and carried away into Babylon.
verses.28:4: And Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles of Judah who entered Babylon, I will bring back to this place, says the Lord, for I will shatter the yoke of the king of Babylon."
verses.28:5: And Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Hananiah the prophet in the sight of the priests and in the sight of all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord,
verses.28:6: and Jeremiah the prophet said, "Amen! May the Lord do so; may the Lord establish your words that you have prophesied, so that the vessels may be brought back into the house of the Lord, and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
verses.28:7: However, listen to this word that I speak in your ears and in the ears of the whole people:
verses.28:8: the prophets who were before me and before you from the beginning prophesied against many lands and against great kingdoms concerning battle, and concerning affliction, and concerning famine;
verses.28:9: the prophet who has prophesied peace, when his word comes about, will be known as the prophet whom the Lord has sent in truth."
verses.28:10: And Hananiah the prophet took the chain from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
verses.28:11: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, "This is what the Lord says: In this way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon after two years of days from the neck of all the nations."
verses.28:12: And Jeremiah the prophet went on his way. And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet broke the chain from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying:
verses.28:13: "Go, and you will say to Hananiah, 'This is what the Lord says: You have shattered wooden chains, and you will make iron chains in place of them.
verses.28:14: For this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I have put an iron yoke upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him; moreover, I have also given him the beasts of the earth.'"
verses.28:15: And Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie.
verses.28:16: Therefore this is what the Lord says: Look, I will send you away from the face of the earth; this year you will die, for you have spoken against the Lord."
verses.28:17: And Hananiah the prophet died in that year, in the seventh month.
verses.29:1: And these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the remnant of the elders of the exile, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had led away from Jerusalem into Babylon,
verses.29:2: after Jeconiah the king, and the lady, and the eunuchs, and the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsman and the locksmith had gone out from Jerusalem,
verses.29:3: by the hand of Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, into Babylon, saying:
verses.29:4: "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles whom I carried away from Jerusalem into Babylon:
verses.29:5: Build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.29:6: Take wives and father sons and daughters; and give wives to your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, and let them bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and do not be few in number.
verses.29:7: And seek the peace of the city to which I caused you to go into exile, and pray for it to the Lord, for in its peace there will be peace for you.
verses.29:8: For this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Do not let your prophets who are in your midst deceive you, nor your diviners, and do not pay attention to your dreams that you yourselves dream;
verses.29:9: for they themselves prophesy falsely to you in My name, and I did not send them, says the Lord.
verses.29:10: For this is what the Lord says: When seventy years begin to be fulfilled in Babylon, I will visit you, and I will raise up My good word over you, so that I may bring you back to this place.
verses.29:11: For I Myself know the thoughts that I ponder concerning you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of affliction, so that I may give you an end and patience.
verses.29:12: And you will call upon Me, and you will go, and you will pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
verses.29:13: You will seek Me and find Me, when you seek Me with your whole heart.
verses.29:14: And I will be found by you, says the Lord; and I will bring back your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations and from all the places to which I drove you out, says the Lord, and I will make you return from the place to which I caused you to go into exile.
verses.29:15: Because you have said, 'The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon':
verses.29:16: for this is what the Lord says to the king who sits on the throne of David, and to all the people who inhabit this city, to your brothers who did not go out with you into exile:
verses.29:17: this is what the Lord of hosts says: Look, I will send the sword, and famine, and plague upon them, and I will make them like bad figs that cannot be eaten because they are very bad:
verses.29:18: and I will pursue them with the sword, and with famine, and with pestilence; and I will give them as an affliction to all the kingdoms of the earth—as a curse, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach to all the nations to which I have cast them out,
verses.29:19: because they did not listen to My words, says the Lord, which He sent to them through My servants the prophets, rising by night and sending; and you did not listen, says the Lord.
verses.29:20: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, all you exiles whom I sent out from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.29:21: This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who prophesy falsely to you in My name: Look, I will hand them over into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes;
verses.29:22: and a curse will be taken up from them by all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, 'May the Lord make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire';
verses.29:23: because they have committed folly in Israel, and have committed adultery with the wives of their friends, and have spoken a word falsely in My name, which I did not command them. I am judge and witness, says the Lord."
verses.29:24: And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall say:
verses.29:25: "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.29:26: 'The Lord has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, so that you may be a leader in the house of the Lord over every man who is mad and prophesying, so that you may put him in the stocks and in prison;
verses.29:27: and now why have you not rebuked Jeremiah the Anathothite, who prophesies to you?
verses.29:28: For on this account he sent to us in Babylon, saying, "It is long: build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruits."'"
verses.29:29: Therefore Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.29:30: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.29:31: "Send to all the exiles, saying, 'This is what the Lord says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he has made you trust in a lie,
verses.29:32: therefore this is what the Lord says: Look, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his seed; he will not have a man living in the midst of this people, and he will not see the good that I will do for My people, says the Lord, because he has spoken rebellion against the Lord.'"
verses.30:1: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.30:2: This is what the Lord God of Israel says: "Write for yourself in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
verses.30:3: For look, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will reverse the reversal of My people Israel and Judah, says the Lord; and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it."
verses.30:4: And these are the words that the Lord spoke to Israel and to Judah:
verses.30:5: For this is what the Lord says: "We have heard a voice of terror; dread, and there is no peace.
verses.30:6: Ask and see whether a male gives birth: why then have I seen the hand of every man upon his waist, like one in labor, and all faces have turned to pallor?
verses.30:7: Woe! For great is that day, and there is none like it; and it is a time of tribulation for Jacob, and out of it he will be saved.
verses.30:8: And it will be on that day, says the Lord of hosts: I will shatter his yoke from your neck, and I will burst his bonds, and foreigners will no longer rule over him;
verses.30:9: but they will serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up for them."
verses.30:10: "Therefore do not fear, My servant Jacob," says the Lord, "and do not be dismayed, Israel; for look, I will save you from a distant land, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob will return, and will rest, and will abound in all good things, and there will be no one whom he fears,
verses.30:11: for I am with you," says the Lord, "to save you. For I will make a complete end among all the nations in which I have scattered you; yet I will not make a complete end of you, but I will discipline you in judgment, so that you may not seem innocent to yourself."
verses.30:12: For this is what the Lord says: "Your fracture is incurable; your wound is most severe;
verses.30:13: there is no one who judges your case for binding up; there is no benefit of remedies for you.
verses.30:14: All your lovers have forgotten you, and they will not seek you; for with the blow of an enemy I have struck you, with cruel chastisement; because of the multitude of your iniquity, your sins have become hard.
verses.30:15: Why do you cry out over your crushing? Your pain is incurable; because of the multitude of your iniquity and because of your hard sins, I have done these things to you.
verses.30:16: Therefore all who eat you will be devoured, and all your enemies will be led into captivity; and those who lay you waste will be laid waste, and all who plunder you I will give as plunder.
verses.30:17: For I will draw a scar over you, and from your wounds I will heal you, says the Lord. For they have called you 'Outcast,' Zion: 'This is the one who had no one seeking her.'"
verses.30:18: This is what the Lord says: "Look, I will reverse the reversal of the tents of Jacob, and I will have mercy on his dwellings; and the city will be built upon its height, and the temple will be founded according to its order;
verses.30:19: and out of them will go forth praise, and the voice of those making merry. And I will multiply them, and they will not be diminished; and I will glorify them, and they will not be weakened.
verses.30:20: And his children will be as from the beginning, and his assembly will remain before Me, and I will punish all who afflict him.
verses.30:21: And his leader will be from him, and a prince will be brought forth from his midst; and I will bring him near, and he will approach Me. For who is this who would apply his heart to draw near to Me?" says the Lord,
verses.30:22: "and you will be a people to Me, and I will be God to you."
verses.30:23: Look, the whirlwind of the Lord, fury going forth, a rushing storm: it will come to rest upon the head of the wicked.
verses.30:24: The Lord will not turn back the anger of indignation until He carries out and completes the thought of His heart; in the last of the days you will understand these things.
verses.31:1: "At that time," says the Lord, "I will be God to all the families of Israel, and they will be a people to Me."
verses.31:2: This is what the Lord says: "The people who had remained from the sword found favor in the desert; Israel will go to his rest."
verses.31:3: From far away the Lord appeared to me. "And with a perpetual love I have loved you; therefore I have drawn you, showing mercy.
verses.31:4: And again I will build you, and you will be built, virgin Israel; once more you will be adorned with your tambourines, and you will go out in the dance of those celebrating.
verses.31:5: Once more you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; the planters will plant, and until the time comes, they will not gather the vintage.
verses.31:6: For there will be a day on which the watchmen on Mount Ephraim will cry out, 'Rise up, and let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.'"
verses.31:7: For this is what the Lord says: "Exult with gladness, Jacob, and neigh against the head of the nations; sound aloud, and sing, and say, 'Save Your people, Lord, the remnant of Israel.'
verses.31:8: Look, I will bring them from the land of the north, and I will gather them from the ends of the earth; among whom will be the blind and the lame, the pregnant woman and the one giving birth together, a great assembly of those returning here.
verses.31:9: With weeping they will come, and in mercy I will lead them back; and I will bring them along streams of water on a straight path, and they will not stumble on it, because I have become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is My firstborn."
verses.31:10: Hear the word of the Lord, nations, and proclaim in the islands that are far away, and say: "He who scattered Israel will gather him and will guard him as a shepherd guards his flock."
verses.31:11: For the Lord has redeemed Jacob and has delivered him from the hand of one stronger.
verses.31:12: And they will come and give praise on Mount Zion, and they will stream together to the good things of the Lord, over the grain, and wine, and oil, and the offspring of flocks and herds; and their soul will be like a watered garden, and they will no longer hunger.
verses.31:13: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, young men and old men together; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and I will comfort them and make them glad after their sorrow.
verses.31:14: And I will saturate the soul of the priests with richness, and My people will be filled with My good things, says the Lord.
verses.31:15: This is what the Lord says: "A voice of lamentation has been heard on high, mourning and weeping of Rachel, wailing for her children and unwilling to be comforted over them, because they are no more."
verses.31:16: This is what the Lord says: "Let your voice cease from wailing, and your eyes from tears, for there is a reward for your work," says the Lord, "and they will return from the land of the enemy;
verses.31:17: and there is hope for your final days," says the Lord, "and the children will return to their own borders."
verses.31:18: Hearing, I have heard Ephraim going into exile: "You have disciplined me, and I have been instructed, like an untamed young bull; turn me back, and I will be turned back, for You are the Lord my God.
verses.31:19: For after You turned me back, I repented; and after You showed me, I struck my thigh. I was put to shame and blushed, because I bore the reproach of my youth."
verses.31:20: Is Ephraim an honorable son to Me? Is he a cherished child? For from the time I spoke about him, I will still remember him. Therefore My inward parts have been stirred over him; showing mercy, I will have mercy on him, says the Lord.
verses.31:21: Set up a watchtower for yourself; place bitternesses for yourself; direct your heart to the straight path on which you walked; return, virgin Israel, return to these cities of yours.
verses.31:22: How long will you be dissolved in luxuries, wandering daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing on the earth: a woman will surround a man.
verses.31:23: This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Once more they will speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I turn back their captivity: 'May the Lord bless you, beauty of righteousness, holy mountain.'
verses.31:24: And Judah and all its cities together will dwell in it, farmers and those driving flocks.
verses.31:25: For I have saturated the weary soul, and I have satisfied every hungry soul."
verses.31:26: Therefore I was awakened as if from sleep, and I looked, and my sleep was sweet to me.
verses.31:27: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of humans and the seed of livestock.
verses.31:28: And just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, to scatter, destroy, and afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," says the Lord.
verses.31:29: In those days they will no longer say, "The fathers ate a sour grape, and the teeth of the children have grown numb."
verses.31:30: Rather, each one will die in his own iniquity; every person who eats a sour grape, his teeth will grow numb.
verses.31:31: "Look, days will come," says the Lord, "and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
verses.31:32: not according to the covenant that I established with their fathers on the day I grasped their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, a covenant that they made void, and I ruled over them," says the Lord.
verses.31:33: "Rather, this will be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days," says the Lord: "I will put My law in their inward parts, and I will write it on their heart, and I will be God to them, and they will be a people to Me;
verses.31:34: and a man will no longer teach his neighbor, nor a man his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest," says the Lord, "because I will be merciful toward their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no longer."
verses.31:35: This is what the Lord says, who gives the sun for the light of day, the order of the moon and the stars for the light of night; who stirs up the sea, and its waves roar; the Lord of hosts is His name:
verses.31:36: "If these laws fail before Me," says the Lord, "then the seed of Israel will also fail, so that it will not be a nation before Me for all days."
verses.31:37: This is what the Lord says: "If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be searched out, then I too will cast off all the seed of Israel because of all that they have done," says the Lord.
verses.31:38: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and the city will be built for the Lord, from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.31:39: And the measuring line will go out further in front of it over the hill of Gareb, and will go around Goah,
verses.31:40: and the whole valley of dead bodies and of ashes, and the entire region of death as far as the brook Kidron, and as far as the corner of the eastern Horse Gate, a holy place of the Lord; it will not be uprooted and will not be destroyed again forever."
verses.32:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah; that is the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.32:2: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the court of the prison that was in the house of the king of Judah.
verses.32:3: For Zedekiah king of Judah had confined him, saying, "Why do you prophesy, saying, 'This is what the Lord says: Look, I will give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it,
verses.32:4: and Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but he will be handed over into the hands of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak with his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes,
verses.32:5: and he will lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him, says the Lord; and if you fight against the Chaldeans, you will have no success'?"
verses.32:6: And Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.32:7: 'Look, Hanamel the son of Shallum, your cousin, will come to you, saying, "Buy for yourself my field that is in Anathoth, for it belongs to you by kinship to buy it."'
verses.32:8: And Hanamel the son of my uncle came to me, according to the word of the Lord, to the courtyard of the prison, and said to me, 'Take possession of my field that is in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin, because the inheritance belongs to you, and you are the next of kin to take possession of it.' Then I understood that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.32:9: And I bought from Hanamel the son of my uncle the field that is in Anathoth, and I weighed out the silver for him: seven staters and ten pieces of silver.
verses.32:10: And I wrote in a document, and sealed it, and called witnesses, and weighed out the silver on a scale.
verses.32:11: And I took the sealed document of possession, and the stipulations, and the ratified terms, and the seals on the outside;
verses.32:12: and I gave the document of possession to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, before the eyes of Hanamel my cousin, before the eyes of the witnesses who were written in the document of purchase, and before the eyes of all the Jews who were sitting in the court of the prison.
verses.32:13: And I commanded Baruch before them, saying,
verses.32:14: 'This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, this sealed document of purchase and this document that is open, and put them in a clay vessel, so that they may last for many days;
verses.32:15: for this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses and fields and vineyards will again be possessed in this land.'
verses.32:16: And I prayed to the Lord, after I handed over the document of possession to Baruch the son of Neriah, saying,
verses.32:17: 'Alas! Alas! Alas! Lord God, look, You made heaven and earth by Your great strength and by Your outstretched arm; no word will be difficult for You,
verses.32:18: who show mercy to thousands and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the lap of their children after them; most mighty, great, and powerful, the Lord of hosts is Your name.
verses.32:19: Great in counsel and incomprehensible in thought, whose eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of Adam, so that You may repay each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his devices.
verses.32:20: You who set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt until this day, and in Israel, and among people, and made a name for Yourself, as it is this day.
verses.32:21: And You led Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt, with signs and with wonders, and with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
verses.32:22: and You gave them this land, which You swore to their fathers that You would give to them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.32:23: And they entered and possessed it, and they did not obey Your voice, and they did not walk in Your law; all the things that You commanded them to do, they did not do, and all these evils have come upon them.
verses.32:24: Look, ramparts have been built up against the city so that it may be captured, and the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it, because of the sword, and famine, and pestilence; and whatever You have spoken has happened, as You Yourself see.
verses.32:25: And You say to me, Lord God, "Buy the field with silver and call witnesses," although the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans?'"
verses.32:26: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.32:27: "Look, I am the Lord God of all flesh. Will any word be difficult for Me?
verses.32:28: Therefore this is what the Lord says: Look, I will hand over this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they will capture it.
verses.32:29: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come, and set it on fire, and burn it up, and the houses on whose rooftops they sacrificed to Baal and poured out drink offerings to foreign gods to provoke Me.
verses.32:30: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah were continually doing evil in My sight from their youth; the sons of Israel, who until now exasperate Me by the work of their hands," says the Lord.
verses.32:31: "For this city has been to Me in fury and in My indignation, from the day on which they built it until this day on which it will be removed from My presence,
verses.32:32: because of the wickedness of the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah, which they did, provoking Me to anger: they and their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.32:33: And they turned their backs to Me, and not their faces, though I taught them early in the morning and instructed them, and they were unwilling to listen so as to receive discipline.
verses.32:34: And they placed their idols in the house in which My name has been called upon, to defile it.
verses.32:35: And they built the high places of Baal that are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to consecrate their sons and their daughters to Molech, which I did not command them, nor did it come up into My heart that they should do this abomination and lead Judah into sin.
verses.32:36: And now, because of these things, this is what the Lord God of Israel says concerning this city, of which you say that it will be handed over into the hands of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by famine, and by plague:
verses.32:37: Look, I will gather them from all the lands to which I drove them out in My fury, and in My anger, and in great indignation; and I will bring them back to this place, and I will make them dwell securely;
verses.32:38: and they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them.
verses.32:39: And I will give them one heart and one way, so that they may fear Me all their days, and that it may be well with them and with their children after them.
verses.32:40: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, and I will not cease to do good to them; and I will put the fear of Me in their heart, so that they will not depart from Me.
verses.32:41: And I will rejoice over them when I do good to them, and I will plant them in this land in truth, with all My heart and with all My soul.
verses.32:42: For this is what the Lord says: Just as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so I will bring upon them all the good that I am speaking to them.
verses.32:43: And fields will be possessed in this land, of which you say that it is deserted, because neither man nor beast has remained, and that it has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans.
verses.32:44: Fields will be bought with money, and they will be written in a document, and a seal will be impressed, and a witness will be called, in the land of Benjamin and around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the plains, and in the cities that are toward the south, for I will turn back their captivity," says the Lord.
verses.33:1: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still confined in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.33:2: "This is what the Lord says, who is about to do it, and to form it, and to prepare it; the Lord is His name:
verses.33:3: Call to Me, and I will hear you, and I will declare to you great and firm things that you do not know.
verses.33:4: For this is what the Lord God of Israel says concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the king of Judah, which have been destroyed, and concerning the ramparts, and concerning the sword
verses.33:5: of those who come to fight with the Chaldeans and to fill them with the corpses of the men whom I struck down in My fury and in My indignation, hiding My face from this city because of all their wickedness:
verses.33:6: Look, I will draw over them a scar and health, and I will cure them, and I will reveal to them the prayer of peace and truth.
verses.33:7: And I will reverse the reversal of Judah and the reversal of Jerusalem, and I will build them up as at the beginning.
verses.33:8: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity in which they sinned against Me, and I will be merciful toward all their iniquities in which they abandoned Me and despised Me.
verses.33:9: And it will be to Me a name, and joy, and praise, and exultation to all the nations of the earth, which will hear of all the good things that I am about to do for them; and they will fear and be troubled at all the good things and at all the peace that I will make for them."
verses.33:10: This is what the Lord says: "There will again be heard in this place, which you say is deserted because there is neither man nor beast in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, which are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without livestock,
verses.33:11: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those saying, 'Give thanks to the Lord of hosts, for the Lord is good, for His mercy is forever,' and of those bringing votive offerings into the house of the Lord; for I will bring back the return of the land as at the beginning," says the Lord.
verses.33:12: This is what the Lord of hosts says: "There will again be in this deserted place, without man and without beast, and in all its cities, a dwelling place of shepherds of resting flocks.
verses.33:13: In the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the plains, and in the cities that are toward the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, flocks will again pass by the hand of the one counting them," says the Lord.
verses.33:14: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will raise up the good word that I spoke to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.33:15: In those days and at that time I will cause a shoot of righteousness to sprout for David, and he will carry out judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.33:16: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell confidently; and this is the name by which they will call him: 'The Lord Our Righteous One.'
verses.33:17: For this is what the Lord says: There will not perish from David a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.33:18: and from the priests and from the Levites there will not perish a man from before My face to offer burnt offerings, and burn an offering, and slay sacrifices all days."
verses.33:19: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.33:20: "This is what the Lord says: If My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night can be made void, so that there is not day and night in their time,
verses.33:21: then My covenant with My servant David will also be able to be made void, so that there is no son from him to reign on his throne, and with the Levites and priests, My ministers.
verses.33:22: Just as the stars of heaven cannot be counted and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the seed of My servant David and the Levites, My ministers."
verses.33:23: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.33:24: "Have you not seen what this people has spoken, saying, 'The two families that the Lord had chosen have been cast off'? And they have despised My people, because it is no longer a nation before them."
verses.33:25: This is what the Lord says: If I have not established My covenant between day and night, and the laws for heaven and earth,
verses.33:26: then indeed I will also cast off the seed of Jacob and of My servant David, so that I will not take from his seed rulers of the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will bring back their return, and I will have mercy on them.
verses.34:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth that were under the authority of his hand, and all the peoples, were waging war against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:
verses.34:2: "This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and you will say to him, 'This is what the Lord says: Look, I will deliver this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire;
verses.34:3: and you will not escape from his hand, but you will certainly be captured, and you will be delivered into his hand; and your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak with your mouth, and you will enter Babylon.
verses.34:4: Nevertheless, hear the word of the Lord, Zedekiah, king of Judah: This is what the Lord says to you: You will not die by the sword,
verses.34:5: but you will die in peace; and according to the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will burn you, and they will lament for you, "Alas, lord!" for I have spoken the word, says the Lord.'"
verses.34:6: And Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem.
verses.34:7: And the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these remained of the cities of Judah, fortified cities.
verses.34:8: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem, proclaiming
verses.34:9: that each one should let his male slave and each one his female slave, a Hebrew man and a Hebrew woman, go free, and by no means hold dominion over them, that is, over a Jew and his brother.
verses.34:10: Therefore all the princes and all the people who had entered into the covenant listened, that each one should let his male slave and each one his female slave go free, and no longer hold dominion over them; so they listened and let them go.
verses.34:11: And afterward they turned back, and took back their male slaves and female slaves whom they had let go free, and subjugated them to be male servants and female servants.
verses.34:12: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.34:13: "This is what the Lord God of Israel says: I made a covenant with your fathers on the day when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:
verses.34:14: 'When seven years have been completed, each one must let go his Hebrew brother who was sold to him; and he will serve you six years, and you will let him go free from you.' Yet your fathers did not listen to Me, nor did they incline their ear.
verses.34:15: And you yourselves turned today, and did what is right in My eyes, to proclaim liberty, each one to his friend; and you entered into a covenant in My presence, in the house where My name has been invoked over it;
verses.34:16: and you turned back, and defiled My name, and brought back, each one his male slave and each one his female slave, whom you had let go so that they might be free and under their own authority, and you subjugated them so that they might be male slaves and female slaves to you.
verses.34:17: Therefore this is what the Lord says: You have not listened to Me, to proclaim liberty, each one to his brother and each one to his friend; look, I proclaim liberty to you, says the Lord, to the sword, to pestilence, and to famine, and I will make you a commotion to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.34:18: And I will give over the men who transgress My covenant and have not kept the words of the covenant to which they agreed in My presence, the calf that they cut into two parts and passed between its divisions,
verses.34:19: the princes of Judah and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the divisions of the calf,
verses.34:20: and I will give them into the hands of their enemies and into the hands of those who seek their life, and their carcass will become food for the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth.
verses.34:21: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes I will give into the hands of their enemies, and into the hands of those who seek their lives, and into the hands of the armies of the king of Babylon, who have withdrawn from you.
verses.34:22: Look, I command, says the Lord, and I will bring them back to this city, and they will battle against it, and capture it, and burn it with fire; and the cities of Judah I will make a desolation, because there is no inhabitant."
verses.35:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying:
verses.35:2: "Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and you will bring them into the house of the Lord, into one chamber of the treasuries, and you will give them wine to drink."
verses.35:3: And I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the entire house of the Rechabites,
verses.35:4: and I brought them into the house of the Lord, to the treasury chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was next to the treasury chamber of the princes, above the treasury of Maaseiah son of Shallum, who was keeper of the vestibule;
verses.35:5: and I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups, and I said to them, "Drink wine."
verses.35:6: They answered, "We will not drink wine, because Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, 'You will not drink wine, you and your sons, forever;
verses.35:7: and you will not build a house, and you will not sow seed, and you will not plant vineyards nor have any; but you will dwell in tents all your days, so that you may live many days upon the face of the land in which you reside as foreigners.'
verses.35:8: Therefore we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, so that we have not drunk wine all our days, we and our wives, our sons and our daughters,
verses.35:9: and have not built houses to dwell in; and we have not had a vineyard, or a field, or seed;
verses.35:10: but we have dwelt in tents, and we have been obedient according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.35:11: However, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to our land, we said, 'Come, and let us enter Jerusalem from before the army of the Chaldeans and from before the army of Syria,' and we remained in Jerusalem."
verses.35:12: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.35:13: "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and say to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, 'Will you not receive instruction, so that you obey My words?—says the Lord.
verses.35:14: The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have prevailed, which he commanded his sons, that they should not drink wine, and they have not drunk to this day, because they obeyed the command of their father; but I have spoken to you, rising early in the morning and speaking, and you have not obeyed Me.
verses.35:15: And I sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising at dawn and sending them, and saying, "Turn back, each one from his most wicked way, and make your pursuits good, and do not follow foreign gods nor worship them, and you will dwell in the land that I gave to you and to your fathers." Yet you did not incline your ear, nor did you listen to Me.
verses.35:16: Therefore the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have upheld the command of their father that he had commanded them; but this people has not obeyed Me.
verses.35:17: For this reason, this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the affliction that I have spoken against them, because I spoke to them, and they did not listen; I called them, and they did not answer Me.'"
verses.35:18: But to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said, "This is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, and have kept all his commandments, and have done all that he commanded you,
verses.35:19: therefore this is what the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: There will not be lacking a man from the lineage of Jonadab son of Rechab, standing in My presence all the days."
verses.36:1: And it happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.36:2: "Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel and Judah, and against all the nations, from the day on which I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah until this day,
verses.36:3: if perhaps, when the house of Judah hears all the evils that I intend to do to them, each one may turn back from his most wicked way, and I will be merciful toward their iniquity and their sin."
verses.36:4: Therefore Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord that He had spoken to him, in a scroll of a book.
verses.36:5: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, "I am confined, and I am not able to enter the house of the Lord.
verses.36:6: So you go in, and read from the scroll in which you wrote the words of the Lord from my mouth, in the hearing of the people in the house of the Lord, on a day of fasting; and moreover, in the hearing of all Judah who come from their cities, you will read to them,
verses.36:7: if perhaps their prayer may fall in the presence of the Lord, and each one may turn back from his most wicked way; for great is the fury and indignation that the Lord has spoken against this people."
verses.36:8: And Baruch son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him, reading from the scroll the words of the Lord in the house of the Lord.
